source:
Donald Trump and Hillary Clinton face off in the 2016 election. While he is well-known among the American public, Trump has never served in elected office. Clinton has served as First Lady, Senator, and Secretary of State. Clinton was the presumptive nominee from start to finish, while Trump has shocked the political world.

How will their campaign play out? Can Trump pull off an upset? Can Clinton continue the legacy of Obama?
zh:
唐纳德·特朗普与希拉里·克林顿在2016年总统选举中正面交锋。特朗普虽为美国公众熟知，却从未担任过民选公职。克林顿曾任第一夫人、参议员和国务卿。克林顿从竞选伊始到获得提名，一直被视为当然的候选人；特朗普却震动了整个政坛。

他们的竞选将如何展开？特朗普能否爆冷获胜？克林顿能否延续奥巴马的政治遗产？

source:
Congratulations! You have won the 2016 election.

In spite of a hard-fought challenge from Hillary Clinton, you have shocked the world with your election victory.

On the political front, you have the bully pulpit in your favor, but support in Congress in uncertain. Will you govern as a more traditional conservative, or will you make a break from orthodoxy?
zh:
恭喜！您赢得了 2016 年大选。

尽管面临来自希拉里·克林顿的艰苦挑战，您的选举胜利震惊了世界。

在政治方面，你的讲坛对你有利，但国会的支持却不确定。你会以更传统的保守派的方式执政，还是会打破正统观念？

source:
Sorry! You have lost the 2016 election.

Many of your supporters are despondent that you have faltered to the likes of Hillary Clinton. Republicans in general believe this was a very winnable election, and are enraged that you came in to blow it. Luckily, there are any number of ways for you to take advantage of your newfound exposure. One rumor even has you founding a television station to profit from the aggrieved sensibilities of your followers. The future is in your hands.
zh:
抱歉！你输掉了 2016 年选举。

你的许多支持者对你对希拉里·克林顿之类的人犹豫不决感到沮丧。共和党人普遍认为这是一场非常有可能获胜的选举，并对你的到来感到愤怒。幸运的是，您可以通过多种方式利用新发现的机会。有传言甚至说你创办了一家电视台，从追随者的愤愤不平中获利。未来掌握在您手中。

source: Sorry, you lost the 2016 election
zh: 抱歉，你输掉了 2016 年选举

source: Where you go from here is up to you. If you are still interested in holding office, you can run for a Senate position or perhaps a governorship. Maybe you can run for president again in 4 years? You could also go the other way and abandon running for politics, maybe taking up a job offer at a TV station. The world is your oyster.
zh: 你从这里去哪里取决于你。如果您仍然有兴趣担任公职，您可以竞选参议院职位或州长职位。也许四年后你可以再次竞选总统？你也可以走另一条路，放弃从政，也许接受电视台的工作机会。世界是你的牡蛎。

source: This was the expected outcome, as it seemed your new brand of politics just didn't sit well with the American public. Obama's legacy will be continued by Clinton through fighting climate change, trying to add a public option to Obamacare, and continuing with his economic prosperity. At least it was fairly close, it could have been much worse. Establishment Republicans are angry at you for losing, swatting aside many of their candidates only to lose to the likes of Clinton.
zh: 这是预期的结果，因为你的新政治品牌似乎不太适合美国公众。奥巴马的遗产将由克林顿通过应对气候变化、尝试为奥巴马医改添加公共选项以及继续其经济繁荣来延续。至少已经相当接近了，情况可能会更糟。共和党建制派对你的失败感到愤怒，他们抛弃了许多候选人，结果却输给了克林顿之类的人。

source: This was the expected outcome, as it seemed your new brand of politics just didn't sit well with the American public. Obama's legacy will be continued by Clinton through fighting climate change, trying to add a public option to Obamacare, and continuing with his economic prosperity, as well as possibly regaining both chambers of congress. Establishment Republicans are incredibly angry that you lost, thinking that 8 years of Obama was their chance to come back to the White House, only for you to come in and stop that.
zh: 这是预期的结果，因为你的新政治品牌似乎不太适合美国公众。奥巴马的遗产将由克林顿延续，通过应对气候变化、尝试为奥巴马医改增加公共选择、继续经济繁荣，以及可能重新赢得国会两院。建制派共和党人对你输了感到非常愤怒，认为奥巴马的 8 年是他们重返白宫的机会，只是你进来阻止了。

source: This was the expected outcome, as it seemed your new brand of politics really didn't sit well with the American public. Obama's legacy will be continued by Clinton through fighting climate change, trying to add a public option to Obamacare, and continuing with his economic prosperity. With their margin of victory, you can assume that Republicans will not be able to stop much of it. Your entire party is incredibly angry about how you threw away a very winnable election, dooming them for the next few years
zh: 这是预期的结果，因为看来你的新政治品牌确实不适合美国公众。奥巴马的遗产将由克林顿通过应对气候变化、尝试为奥巴马医改添加公共选项以及继续其经济繁荣来延续。凭借他们的胜利优势，你可以假设共和党将无法阻止其中的大部分。你们整个政党都对你们如何放弃一场非常有可能获胜的选举感到非常愤怒，这让他们在未来几年里注定失败

source: However, in one of the most bizzarre situations that could have unfolded this election, you actually WON the popular vote, despite losing the election! Maybe their will be bipartisan support for removal of the electoral college now...
zh: 然而，在本次选举可能发生的最奇怪的情况之一中，尽管输掉了选举，但您实际上赢得了普选！也许他们现在会得到两党支持删除选举人团......

source: Congratulations! You won the 2016 election
zh: 恭喜！你赢得了 2016 年选举

source: It's now up to you what you do as president. Maybe you go full-on populist, as you did in the campaign, or appeal to the establishment with some more orthodox Republican policy. Either way, you will be making history by this win.
zh: 现在由你决定作为总统做什么。也许你会像在竞选中那样全面推行民粹主义，或者用一些更正统的共和党政策来吸引建制派。无论哪种方式，您都将通过这场胜利创造历史。

source: Wow! You outperformed nearly every expectation out there, and have taken the US political landscape by storm. Clinton calls to concede and congratulate you, and the Senate and House majorities grow to healthy proportions in the wake of your victory. You give a victory speech to a roaring crowd of thousands in New York City, while the rest of the world is silent with shock.
zh: 哇！你们的表现几乎超出了所有人的预期，并席卷了美国政治格局。克林顿呼吁承认并祝贺你，参议院和众议院的多数席位在你获胜后增长到健康的比例。你向纽约州城市的数千名欢呼雀跃的人群发表了胜利演讲，而世界其他地方则因震惊而保持沉默。

source: Wow! You outperformed the expectations of many, and have taken the US political landscape by storm. Clinton calls to concede and congratulate you, and the Senate and House remain relatively stable. You give a victory speech to a roaring crowd of thousands in New York City, while the rest of the world tries to figure out what happened.
zh: 哇！你的表现超出了许多人的预期，席卷了美国政坛。克林顿呼吁认输，恭喜你，参众两院保持相对稳定。你在纽约州市向数千名欢呼雀跃的人群发表胜利演讲，而世界其他地方则试图弄清楚发生了什么。

source: Wow! You outperformed most polls, and have taken the US political landscape by storm. Clinton calls to concede and congratulate you, and the Senate and House stay in the Republicans' hands. You give a victory speech to a roaring crowd of thousands in New York City, while the Democrats give a muffled congratulations.
zh: 哇！你的表现超过了大多数民意调查，并席卷了美国政治格局。克林顿呼吁承认并祝贺你，参议院和众议院仍掌握在共和党手中。您向纽约州市数千名欢呼雀跃的人群发表胜利演讲，而民主党则低声表示祝贺。

source: In yet another situation that is sure to anger Democrats, you have lost the popular vote, despite winning the election. You can bet the electoral college is going to be discussed a lot over the next 4 years, but you're not going to let anything happen to it, will you?
zh: 在另一种肯定会激怒民主党的情况下，尽管赢得了选举，但你还是失去了普选。您可以打赌，选举人团在接下来的 4 年里将会被广泛讨论，但您不会让它发生任何事情，不是吗？

source: Sorry, you lose the 2016 election
zh: 抱歉，你输掉了 2016 年选举

source: For you, it seems your political career is over. Bernie Sanders's supporters are angered that you cast their candidate aside, only to lose to a populist like Trump. Whatever happens, your legacy as a politician will be most certainly historical
zh: 对你来说，你的政治生涯似乎已经结束了。伯尼·桑德斯的支持者对你抛弃他们的候选人而感到愤怒，结果却输给了像特朗普这样的民粹主义者。无论发生什么，你作为政治家的遗产无疑将具有历史意义

source: Despite the seemingly endless confidence everyone around the world had in you winning, you just weren't able to pull through. It seems the endless barrage of right-wing attacks was just too much for you to handle. Time will tell what Trump does in office, although with gains in both chambers for Democrats, he will certainly have to tone down some of his promises.
zh: 尽管世界各地的每个人似乎都对你获胜充满信心，但你就是没能渡过难关。右翼无休止的攻击似乎让你难以应对。时间会告诉我们特朗普在任期间会做什么，尽管民主党在参众两院都取得了进展，但他肯定不得不减弱一些承诺。

source: Despite the seemingly endless confidence everyone around the world had in you winning, you just weren't able to pull through. It seems the endless barrage of right-wing attacks was just too much for you to handle. Time will tell what Trump does in office, although with similar margins in the House and Senate to 2014, he will have not too much resistance.
zh: 尽管世界各地的每个人似乎都对你获胜充满信心，但你就是没能渡过难关。右翼无休止的攻击似乎让你难以应对。时间会告诉我们特朗普在任期间会做什么，尽管众议院和参议院的优势与 2014 年相似，但他不会遇到太多阻力。

source: Despite the seemingly endless confidence everyone around the world had in you winning, you just weren't able to pull through. It seems the endless barrage of right-wing attacks was just too much for you to handle. Time will tell what Trump does in office, although with the gains they make in each chamber, the only respite the Democrats will have is the midterms.
zh: 尽管世界各地的每个人似乎都对你获胜充满信心，但你就是没能渡过难关。右翼无休止的攻击似乎让你难以应对。时间会告诉我们特朗普在任期间会做什么，尽管随着他们在各议院取得的进展，民主党唯一的喘息机会就是中期选举。

source: Possibly most agonizing of all is the fact that you won the popular vote despite losing the election. You and your fellow Democrats are sure to be discussing the electoral college again for a while, but don't expect a Trump presidency to do anything about it...
zh: 最令人痛苦的可能是，尽管输掉了选举，但你还是赢得了普选。您和您的民主党同僚肯定会再次讨论选举人团一段时间，但不要指望特朗普总统对此采取任何行动......

source: The options you have for policy are quite open. Will you extend an olive branch to the Sanders supporters and pivot left, or will you stick to your centrist views and be a bipartisan president? Either way, you'll be very polarizing, so let’s hope you can calm down America after this campaign season.
zh: 您的政策选择非常开放。您会向桑德斯支持者伸出橄榄枝并左转，还是会坚持中间派观点并成为两党总统？不管怎样，你都会变得两极分化，所以我们希望你能在这个竞选季节之后让美国平静下来。

source: Congratulations! Despite an intense and vicious battle cast by the Republicans, you have become the first female president and fought off Donald Trump. With your impressively large victory, you also managed to win a number of victories down-ballot, thus making things easier for you.
zh: 恭喜！尽管共和党进行了激烈而恶毒的斗争，您还是成为了第一位女总统并进行了战斗唐纳德·特朗普。凭借令人印象深刻的巨大胜利，您还赢得了一些下选的胜利，从而使事情变得更容易。

source: Congratulations! Despite an intense and vicious battle cast by the Republicans, you have become the first female president and fought off Donald Trump. Your victory margin gives you some breathing room in the chambers, so make sure you act on your promises or the 2018 midterms will be brutal.
zh: 恭喜！尽管共和党进行了激烈而恶毒的斗争，您还是成为了第一位女总统并进行了战斗唐纳德·特朗普。你的胜率让你在众议院有一些喘息的空间，所以一定要兑现你的承诺，否则 2018 年的中期选举将是残酷的。

source: Congratulations! Despite an intense and vicious battle cast by the Republicans, you have become the first female president and fought off Donald Trump. Your victory margin, as small as it is, will force you to be a bit bipartisan, but your years in the government prepared you for this.
zh: 恭喜！尽管共和党进行了激烈而恶毒的斗争，您还是成为了第一位女总统并进行了战斗唐纳德·特朗普。尽管你的胜率微乎其微，但你会被迫采取两党合作的态度，但你在政府任职的岁月已经为此做好了准备。

source: In one of the strangest events that took place during this campaign, you didn't end up winning the popular vote, despite winning the electoral vote! Republicans are quite angry about this, and you can't help but crack a smile, and wonder why you and Bill could never surpass 50% of the popular vote. Maybe in 2020?
zh: 在本次竞选期间发生的最奇怪的事件之一中，尽管您赢得了选举人票，但最终并未赢得普选！共和党人对此非常愤怒，你不禁会心一笑，并想知道为什么你和比尔永远无法超过 50% 的普选票。也许在 2020 年？

source: John McCain is certainly not all too happy about you winning, however, especially with his former running mate...
zh: 约翰·麦凯恩当然对你获胜不太高兴，尤其是和他的前竞选搭档……

source: The options you have for policy are quite open. With your choice of Sanders as a running mate, you have sent a message about what you want to do during your term, so many expect some action on climate change and workers rights to come quickly, and with efficacy. Whatever you do, you'll be very polarizing, so let’s hope you can calm down America after this campaign season.
zh: 您的政策选择非常开放。通过您选择桑德斯作为竞选搭档，您已经发出了关于您在任期内想要做什么的信息，因此许多人期望针对气候变化和工人权利采取一些行动，并迅速有效。无论你做什么，你都会变得非常两极分化，所以我们希望你能在这个竞选季节之后让美国平静下来。

source: Your use of Twitter has garnered outsized attention in your run for the Republican nomination, but some advisors are leery of your erratic tendnecies on that site. How will you proceed?
zh: 在竞选共和党提名过程中，您对 Twitter 的使用引起了极大关注，但一些顾问对您在该网站上不稳定的倾向持怀疑态度。你将如何进行？

source: The FBI director has handed down a severe criticism of Clinton's email practices while Secretary of State, though he declined to recommend any indictments. Do you have any comment?
zh: 联邦调查局局长对克林顿在担任国务卿期间的电子邮件做法提出了严厉批评，但他拒绝建议任何起诉。您有何评论？

source: There was a mass shooting at a gay nightclub in Orlando overnight, perpetrated by a Muslim, resulting in 50 people killed. What is your reaction?
zh: 奥兰多一家同性恋夜总会夜间发生大规模枪击事件，凶手是一名穆斯林，造成 50 人死亡。你的反应是什么？

source: What was your rationale behind selecting Mike Pence as your running mate?
zh: 您选择迈克·彭斯作为竞选搭档的理由是什么？

source: What will your message be as you accept the Republican nomination for President on national television?
zh: 当您在国家电视台接受共和党总统提名时，您会传达什么信息？

source: In the wake of your nomination, a few anti-Trump conservatives are organizing to cast votes for Evan McMullin as a protest, with an emphasis on the Western states. What are your thoughts?
zh: 在你获得提名后，一些反特朗普的保守派正在组织投票给埃文·麦克马林 (Evan McMullin) 以示抗议，重点是西部各州。你有什么想法？

source: There has been a violent terrorist attack in Nice today, resulting in the deaths of almost 100 people. How will you address this?
zh: 尼斯今天发生暴力恐怖袭击，造成近百人死亡。您将如何解决这个问题？

source: Pundits have started questioning the so-called Pence Rule, based on your running-mate's refusal to dine alone with a woman. What are your thoughts?
zh: 专家们已经开始质疑所谓的彭斯规则，因为你的竞选搭档拒绝与女性单独用餐。你有什么想法？

source: Do you have plans to attack the Supreme Court for their ruling on gay marriage in 2015?
zh: 您是否计划攻击最高法院 2015 年对同性婚姻的裁决？

source: How do you plan to address Obamacare as you campaign?
zh: 您计划在竞选时如何解决奥巴马医改问题？

source: In a hearing today, a New York judge has set the trial date for the Trump University lawsuit to December of this year. Do you have any comment?
zh: 在今天的听证会上，纽约州法官将特朗普大学诉讼的审判日期定为今年 12 月。您有何评论？

source: While attending a 9/11 memorial event today, Hillary Clinton was caught on video going limp and being carried into a van, apparently for medical attention. Do you have any comment?
zh: 今天在参加 9/11 纪念活动时，视频拍到希拉里·克林顿变得跛行并被抬进一辆货车，显然是为了接受医疗救助。您有何评论？

source: A video surfaced of you describing how you tried to seduce a married woman, and how you can generally kiss women or "grab them by the pussy". 14 women have also stepped forward to accuse you of assault. What is your response?
zh: 一段视频浮出水面，视频中您描述了您如何试图引诱已婚女性，以及您通常如何亲吻女性或“抓住她们的阴户”。 14名女性也站出来指控你殴打。你的回应是什么？

source: A leaked transcript from Wikileaks shows the Clinton campaign working with members of the DNC to collaborate against the campaign of Bernie Sanders in subtle but definite ways, such as the sharing of some debate questions before a primary debate. How do you respond?
zh: 维基解密泄露的文字记录显示，克林顿竞选活动与 DNC 成员合作，以微妙但明确的方式合作反对伯尼·桑德斯竞选活动，例如在初选辩论前分享一些辩论问题。你如何回应？

source: A leaked transcript from Wikileaks shows Hillary Clinton saying in a closed-door speech at Goldman Sachs that she is "center-left, center-right" and that she supports "open trade and open borders". How do you respond?
zh: 维基解密泄露的文字记录显示，希拉里·克林顿在高盛的一次闭门演讲中表示，她是“中左翼、中右翼”，并且支持“开放贸易和开放边界”。你如何回应？

source: James Comey, FBI Director, has made a late announcement that additional emails have surfaced in Hillary Clinton's case, thanks to an investigation into Anthony Weiner. What are your thoughts?
zh: FBI 局长詹姆斯·科米 (James Comey) 最新宣布，由于对安东尼·韦纳 (Anthony Weiner) 的调查，希拉里·克林顿案件中出现了更多电子邮件。你有什么想法？

source: Where will you spend the final day of your campaign?
zh: 您将在哪里度过竞选活动的最后一天？

source: These are the same people who said my campaign was hopeless and gave me terrible advice for the last year and a half. Not too smart!
zh: 正是这些人说我的竞选活动毫无希望，并在过去的一年半里给了我糟糕的建议。不太聪明！

source: In this day and age you gotta use social media. You gotta. Now I think we can all agree that a general election is different from a primary so I might tone it down a little on some things, but you gotta use social media.
zh: 在当今时代，您必须使用社交媒体。你必须。现在我想我们都同意大选与初选不同，所以我可能会在某些事情上稍微缓和一些，但你必须使用社交媒体。

source: I'm the best thing that's happened to CNN since the Gulf War. If I stop tweeting for a couple of weeks, they'll run a story about me every hour asking why!
zh: 我是自海湾战争以来 CNN 发生的最好的事情。如果我停止发推文几周，他们就会每小时发布一个关于我的故事来询问为什么！

source: Mike Pence is an incredible, incredible human being. He's been in there for many years, fighting for religious liberty, tax cuts, and a strong military.
zh: 迈克·彭斯是一个令人难以置信的、令人难以置信的人。他在那里工作了很多年，为宗教自由、减税和强大的军队而奋斗。

source: This is a guy with a terrific record in state government, really terrific as Governor of Indiana. A wonderful Congressman you might have heard. And we need experience. Experience is very important.
zh: 这是一个在州政府中有着出色记录的人，作为印第安纳州的州长真的很棒。您可能听说过一位出色的国会议员。我们需要经验。经验非常重要。

source: This investigation by our so-called FBI was a farce from start to finish. How can someone destroy massive amounts of evidence in the midst of a federal investigation and not be charged?
zh: 我们所谓的FBI的这次调查从头到尾都是一场闹剧。一个人怎么能在联邦调查过程中销毁大量证据而不受到指控呢？

source: I'm deeply concerned about this whole episode. We don't know yet whether there was a crime or not, but you can be sure that a Trump Administration will be looking into this some more.
zh: 我对整个事件深感担忧。我们还不知道是否存在犯罪行为，但可以肯定的是，特朗普政府将进一步调查此事。

source: I have the utmost respect for James Comey and our terrific agents in the FBI. It seems like Hillary may have gotten lucky on this one.
zh: 我对詹姆斯·科米和我们联邦调查局出色的特工怀有最大的敬意。看来希拉里在这一点上可能很幸运。

source: Around the world we have Islamic terror striking at innocent lives, while the Democrats do nothing. If this attack on the LGBT community, this vicious attack, isn't enough to make them wake up, then what is?
zh: 在世界各地，伊斯兰恐怖袭击了无辜的生命，而民主党却无所作为。如果这种针对LGBT群体的攻击，这种恶毒的攻击，还不足以让他们警醒，那什么才是？

source: Appreciate the congrats for being right on radical Islamic terrorism, I don't want congrats, I want toughness & vigilance. We must be smart!
zh: 感谢您在激进伊斯兰恐怖主义问题上的正确做法，我不想要恭喜，我想要强硬和警惕。我们一定要聪明！

source: First of all, our hearts and prayers really go out to everyone affected by this shooting, and particularly the victims. But it would be a real tragedy if we used this incident as an excuse to restrict our constitutional rights.
zh: 首先，我们向所有受到这起枪击案影响的人，尤其是受害者，致以关怀和祈祷。但如果我们借此为由，限制宪法赋予我们的权利，那才是真正的悲剧。

source: What happened in Orlando last right was a terrible tragedy, and our thoughts and prayers go out to everyone affected.
zh: 奥兰多最后发生的事情是一场可怕的悲剧，我们向所有受影响的人表示哀悼和祈祷。

source: I am the true conservative when it comes to gun rights, abortion, taxes, and many other issues. It would be terrible if we let the left-wing media divide us in the face of Hillary Clinton.
zh: 在枪支权利、堕胎、税收和许多其他问题上，我是真正的保守派。如果我们让左翼媒体在希拉里·克林顿面前分裂我们，那就太可怕了。

source: The leadership of this country has been a disaster, and because of this many lies have been spread about me. I am the one who can fix our problems with trade, with ISIS, with Obamacare, and with many other issues.
zh: 这个国家的领导层是一场灾难，因此，关于我的许多谎言被传播。我是能够解决我们的贸易问题、伊斯兰国问题、奥巴马医改问题以及许多其他问题的人。

source: I will compare and contrast my stellar business record with the corruption and incompetence of Hillary Clinton, and remind voters of my views on Obamacare, tax cuts, and immigration. We're going to Make America Great Again.
zh: 我会将我出色的商业记录与希拉里·克林顿的腐败和无能进行比较和对比，并提醒选民我对奥巴马医改、减税和移民的看法。我们要去让美国再次伟大。

source: I am self-funding and independent from special interests. Hillary Clinton has taken money from Goldman Sachs, Saudi Arabia, Russia, and many large donors within the United States. Who do you trust?
zh: 我自筹资金，独立于特殊利益。希拉里·克林顿已从高盛、沙特阿拉伯、俄罗斯和美国境内的许多大型捐助者处获得资金。你信任谁？

source: Evan who? Have you seen this guy? I'm not too worried!
zh: 埃文是谁？你见过这个人吗？我不太担心！

source: Hillary Clinton deleted 32,000 emails under House Subpoena, along with many other crimes. When people see that I'm the only one who can defeat Crooked Hillary, they will reject this nonsense.
zh: 希拉里·克林顿根据众议院传票删除了 32,000 封电子邮件以及许多其他犯罪行为。当人们看到我是唯一能击败狡猾的希拉里的人时，他们就会拒绝这种废话。

source: We have some strong statements to make on foreign policy, on federal judges, on religious freedom and taxes, that I think are really gonna show people I'm serious.
zh: 我们对外交政策、联邦法官、宗教自由和税收发表了一些强有力的声明，我认为这些声明确实会向人们表明我是认真的。

source: This is a minor civil case, pursued by a few disgruntled people for political purposes. Many many people were very satisfied with Trump University.
zh: 这是一起小型民事案件，由一些心怀不满的人出于政治目的而追究。许多人对特朗普大学非常满意。

source: Where is Hillary Clinton's apology for the email server, the war in Iraq, the dead ambassador in Benghazi, the Goldman Sachs speeches, and so many other issues of importance?
zh: 希拉里·克林顿对电子邮件服务器、伊拉克战争、班加西大使去世、高盛演讲以及许多其他重要问题的道歉在哪里？

source: Some people under me put this scheme together, and when I found out, I fired them. It's as simple as that. This whole thing is the media trying to set up a false equivalency between myself and Crooked Hillary.
zh: 我手下的一些人策划了这个计划，当我发现后，我解雇了他们。就这么简单。这整件事是媒体试图在我和狡猾的希拉里之间建立一个错误的等同物。

source: Another horrific attack, this time in Nice, France. Many dead and injured. When will we learn? It is only getting worse.
zh: 又一起可怕的袭击，这次发生在法国尼斯。许多人死伤。我们什么时候才能学会？情况只会变得更糟。

source: As President, in spite of what people in the liberal media say, I will work very closely with our foreign allies on issues of importance. Together we can unite against and defeat radical Islamic terror.
zh: 作为总统，无论自由派媒体怎么说，我都将在重要问题上与我们的外国盟友密切合作。我们可以团结起来反对并击败激进的伊斯兰恐怖主义。

source: My heart goes out to the fantastic and resilient people of France, it's one of the most beautiful countries, as they deal with unspeakable tragedy.
zh: 我的心与法国人民的出色和坚韧同在，它是最美丽的国家之一，因为他们正在应对难以形容的悲剧。

source: She went on television after this attack and she lied. All to cover up her own failures in security. And now she wants to be President?
zh: 这次袭击后她上了电视，她撒了谎。这一切都是为了掩盖她自己在安全方面的失败。现在她想当总统？

source: I will do a much better job than the clueless Democrats when it comes our national security. Democrats couldn't even guard a single embassy, and they say they can defeat ISIS?
zh: 当涉及到我们的国家安全时，我会比无能的民主党人做得更好。民主党连一个大使馆都守不住，还说能打败ISIS？

source: There have been some interesting investigations into this that the American people should look into. But my focus now, we have the economy, China, and so many of these other issues.
zh: 对此进行了一些有趣的调查，美国人民应该调查一下。但我现在的重点是经济、中国以及许多其他问题。

source: You better believe under my Administration, we're going to be focusing on America first, and not on these idiotic wars and trade deals. Do you think Hillary Clinton feels the same way?
zh: 你最好相信在我的政府领导下，我们将专注于美国优先，而不是这些愚蠢的战争和贸易协议。你认为希拉里·克林顿有同样的感觉吗？

source: Hillary Clinton keeps saying that I'm unqualified to serve as President, so what was going on her brain when she voted for the war in Iraq?
zh:
希拉里·克林顿一直说我没有资格担任总统，那她投票支持伊拉克战争时脑子里在想什么呢？
如果他选择她作为竞选伙伴，

source: The political establishment on both sides got it dead wrong on Iraq. And now we have ISIS. I am the candidate who can destroy ISIS and radical Islamic terrorism!
zh: 双方的政治建制派在伊拉克问题上都大错特错。现在我们有了伊斯兰国。我是能够摧毁伊斯兰国和激进伊斯兰恐怖主义的候选人！

source: Bill Clinton is a sick man and his people, including Hillary, have silenced a number of women over the years who tried to speak out.
zh: 比尔·克林顿是一个病人，他的人民，包括希拉里，多年来一直让一些试图发声的女性保持沉默。

source: I am really hoping to keep this campaign focused on the issues, but if Hillary wants to use this "war on women" nonsense, I reserve the right to call her out on it, along with Bill.
zh: 我真的希望这场竞选活动能够集中在这些问题上，但如果希拉里想要使用这种“对女性的战争”的废话，我保留权利谴责她和比尔。

source: We need this campaign to focus on the substantive issues, like Obama's assault on religious freedom and free speech. There are plenty of people out there digging up dirt on the Clintons.
zh: 我们需要这场运动关注实质性问题，例如奥巴马对宗教自由和言论自由的攻击。有很多人在挖掘克林顿夫妇的丑闻。

source: Over the years I've actually been tremendous friends with the Clintons. I really have. While they would be a disaster for the country, I don't want to get into that messy personal stuff.
zh: 多年来，我实际上一直是克林顿夫妇的好朋友。我真的有。虽然这对国家来说将是一场灾难，但我不想卷入那些混乱的个人事务。

source: Build the wall! Mexico has exploited our country for twenty years now, dumping murders, rapists, and worse onto our system and stealing our jobs with NAFTA. Believe me, that's not going to last.
zh: 筑墙！墨西哥已经剥削我们的国家二十年了，将谋杀、强奸犯和更糟糕的事情倾倒在我们的系统上，并通过北美自由贸易协定窃取了我们的工作。相信我，这不会持续太久。

source: I was using "rapists" as a figure of speech. But I will, you know, remind people that Hillary Clinton was saying she was "adamantly against illegal immigrants". What made her change her mind?
zh: 我用“强奸犯”作为比喻。但你知道，我会提醒人们，希拉里·克林顿说她“坚决反对非法移民”。是什么让她改变了主意？

source: Mexicans are beautiful, beautiful people. It's unfortunate how some people in the media tried to twist a couple of words around to make it sound like something completely different. But that's how they operate.
zh: 墨西哥人是非常美丽的人。不幸的是，一些媒体人士试图歪曲几个词，让它听起来完全不同。但这就是他们的运作方式。

source: We almost had immigration reform. A beautiful deal, except that some radical Democrats wouldn't agree to the border security. But I think they'll see the light once they lose this fall.
zh: 我们几乎进行了移民改革。这是一项美好的协议，只是一些激进的民主党人不同意边境安全。但我认为一旦他们今年秋天失利，他们就会看到曙光。

source: We're going to end NAFTA and we're going to get a new deal with China when I'm President. What's happened with trade in the last twenty years is a disgrace.
zh: 当我担任总统时，我们将结束北美自由贸易协定，并且我们将与中国达成新政。过去二十年来贸易所发生的事情是一种耻辱。

source: You better believe that TPP is dead, from day one of my Presidency. And we're going to be looking into some of these other deals too and we'll be very careful about the trade deficit.
zh: 从我担任总统的第一天起，你最好相信 TPP 已经死了。我们也将研究其中一些其他交易，我们将对贸易赤字非常小心。

source: We've got a lot of issues to focus on and galvanize people. It seems like people respond a lot better, to be honest, they respond better when I'm talking about the corruption of the Clintons. About guns, you know, that kind of thing.
zh: 我们有很多问题需要关注并激励人们。看起来人们的反应要好得多，说实话，当我谈论克林顿夫妇的腐败时，他们的反应更好了。关于枪支，你知道的，诸如此类的事情。

source: I love free trade. This is another case where the media has taken a couple of sentences in a three-hour speech and made up a totally phony story. All I am saying is we've got to look out for America first in these trade deals.
zh: 我喜欢自由贸易。这又是媒体在三个小时的演讲中摘取几句话，编造出一个完全虚假的故事的案例。我想说的是，我们必须在这些贸易协议中留意美国优先。

source: I'm probably the most pro-life individual, maybe ever. And you know, one of the big issues in this election is the judges. Very important issue.
zh: 我可能是最反堕胎的人，也许是有史以来。你知道，这次选举的一大问题是法官。非常重要的问题。

source: I disagree with Roe v. Wade, deeply to my core. Now there might be a couple of exceptions we can talk about, but I am a very pro-life person.
zh: 我不同意 罗诉韦德案，深入我的核心。现在我们可以讨论一些例外情况，但我是一个非常反堕胎的人。

source: Life is one of those beautiful, beautiful things, it really is. And a lot of people, you know, it's always surprised me how many people have mixed feelings about life.
zh: 生活是一件非常美丽的事情，确实如此。很多人，你知道，有多少人对生活有着复杂的感受，这总是让我感到惊讶。

source: One thing we've really got to do is make the Republican Party more inclusive. We used to get so many votes, and there are a lot of people out there more concerned about their jobs, about this illegal immigration farce, and many other things.
zh: 我们真正要做的一件事是让共和党更具包容性。我们过去获得了很多选票，而且有很多人更关心他们的工作，关心这场非法移民闹剧，以及许多其他事情。

source: ISIS and radical Islamic terrorism is the greatest threat to our wonderful nation. I will mercilessly combat radical Islam from my first day in office, including a Muslim ban.
zh: ISIS 和激进的伊斯兰恐怖主义是对我们美好国家的最大威胁。从上任第一天起，我将无情地打击激进的伊斯兰教，包括禁止穆斯林。

source: We are going to have a team of fantastic individuals looking into this issue from the first day I am President. And I would hate for it... but we wouldn't take a Muslim ban off the table.
zh: 从我担任总统的第一天起，我们将拥有一支由出色的个人组成的团队来研究这个问题。我会讨厌它......但我们不会取消穆斯林禁令。

source: The media totally leaves out the part where I said the ban should be temporary, until we can figure out what's going on. But they want to paint me as some kind of bigot to further their liberal agenda for America.
zh: 媒体完全忽略了我所说的禁令应该是暂时的部分，直到我们弄清楚发生了什么。但他们想把我描绘成某种偏执狂，以推进他们对美国的自由主义议程。

source: Maybe I will. Maybe I won't. I'm sure the fake media will be very interested to find out when I win the election in November.
zh: 也许我会的。也许我不会。我确信假媒体会非常有兴趣知道我何时赢得 11 月份的选举。

source: There are some very serious questions out there about her stamina. And another thing, her people lied about this whole incident until that video came out. Notice how Hillary has barely been campaigning at all the last few weeks?
zh: 关于她的耐力存在一些非常严重的问题。另一件事是，她的人对整个事件撒了谎，直到视频发布为止。注意到过去几周希拉里几乎没有参加竞选活动吗？

source: The most important thing right now is to remember our heroes from 9/11. I will be making a number of campaign stops these next few days where I mention our veterans, and our other heroes.
zh: 现在最重要的事情是记住 9/11 的英雄。在接下来的几天里，我将在许多竞选活动中提及我们的退伍军人和我们的其他英雄。

source: In spite of everything, I hate to see something like this. You know, she was at my wedding. A lot of people forget that, but I never want to see her undergo physical harm. I wish Hillary a speedy recovery and I'm sending her my thoughts.
zh: 无论如何，我讨厌看到这样的事情。你知道，她参加了我的婚礼。很多人都忘记了这一点，但我不想看到她受到身体伤害。我祝愿希拉里早日康复，我正在向她传达我的想法。

source: These moderators ganged up on John McCain. They ganged up on Mitt Romney. I don't understand why Republicans keep going up there to let some hack from MSNBC browbeat them in front of 50 million people.
zh: 这些版主联合起来攻击约翰·麦凯恩。他们联合起来攻击米特·罗姆尼。我不明白为什么共和党人总是让 MSNBC 的黑客在 5000 万人面前恐吓他们。

source: Believe me, I can't wait to debate Hillary Clinton.
zh: 相信我，我迫不及待地想辩论希拉里·克林顿。

source: Obamacare is one of the biggest disasters in the history of the United States. We're going to totally repeal this monstrosity and let free enterprise fix our health care system.
zh: 奥巴马医改是美国历史上最大的灾难之一。我们将彻底废除这个怪物，让自由企业修复我们的医疗保健系统。

source: We're going to repeal and replace Obamacare under my Administration. And under my new plan, people are going to get unbelievable health care like they've never seen before.
zh: 我们将在我的政府领导下废除并取代奥巴马医改。根据我的新计划，人们将获得前所未有的令人难以置信的医疗保健服务。

source: We need to be talking more about a massive infrastructure bill, and putting our factory workers and our coal miners back to work.
zh: 我们需要更多地讨论大规模的基础设施法案，并让我们的工厂工人和煤矿工人重返工作岗位。

source: Obama's disastrous management has driven this program into the ground. We're going to stop the rate increases and the disaster stories of people being turned away from the health care they deserve.
zh: 奥巴马灾难性的管理导致该计划陷入困境。我们将阻止利率上升和人们被拒绝获得应有的医疗保健的灾难故事。

source: This decision is a real perversion of the Constitution. I think a lot of people are really upset about this and I hear about it every day. And believe me, we're going to do something about it.
zh: 这一决定是对宪法的真正歪曲。我认为很多人对此感到非常不安，我每天都会听到这样的事情。相信我，我们会为此做点什么。

source: What's wrong with letting New York decide this issue one way, and many other states can decide it the other way? I mean, am I nuts here?
zh: 让纽约州以一种方式决定这个问题，而许多其他州可以以另一种方式决定，这有什么问题吗？我是说，我疯了吗？

source: I'm going to appoint judges who are extremely strong on the Second Amendment, and on Roe v. Wade. Very important issues.
zh: 我将任命对第二修正案非常强有力的法官，并且 罗诉韦德案。非常重要的问题。

source: I thought it was very interesting when this decision was handed down. And not all the judges agreed, but you know, what can I really say about it? These are extremely intelligent people, these judges.
zh: 当这个决定下达时，我觉得非常有趣。并不是所有的评委都同意，但你知道，对此我能说什么呢？这些法官都是非常聪明的人。

source: This outrage is an elitist conspiracy to undermine my chances in the final days of this race. NBC was sitting on this video for 11 years! It almost reminds you of what they did to Bush in 2000.
zh: 这种愤怒是精英主义的阴谋，目的是破坏我在这场竞选最后几天的机会。 NBC 已经坐视这个视频 11 年了！它几乎让你想起他们在 2000 年对布什所做的事情。

source: I said some things in a private conversation that I shouldn't have, but think about what's at stake in this election. And think about all the times that Hillary Clinton helped her husband abuse and silence women.
zh: 我在私人谈话中说了一些不应该说的话，但想想这次选举的利害关系。想想希拉里·克林顿帮助她的丈夫虐待和压制女性的所有时间。

source: It's not often that I feel shame. People who know me can agree. But I am very sorry for the way I acted in this situation, and we can't allow one ill-advised conversation to derail the entire future of the United States.
zh: 我并不经常感到羞耻。认识我的人都会同意。但我对我在这种情况下的行为感到非常抱歉，我们不能允许一次不明智的谈话破坏美国的整个未来。

source: As usual, Hillary has been caught telling lies. For all we know, this is just the beginning. Do we really want a President, and then a month after they're elected we find out they're being blackmailed by Russia or China?
zh: 像往常一样，希拉里被发现说谎。据我们所知，这只是一个开始。我们真的想要一位总统，然后在他们当选一个月后我们发现他们受到俄罗斯或中国的勒索吗？

source: No wonder she was working so hard to cheat Bernie Sanders out of the nomination. She's the Goldman Sachs candidate, folks, plain and simple.
zh: 难怪她如此努力地欺骗伯尼·桑德斯以获得提名。伙计们，简单明了，她是高盛的候选人。

source: If it's really true that Russia collaborated to release this information about Hillary Clinton's private speeches to Goldman Sachs, then I totally disavow and denounce these illegal leaks.
zh: 如果俄罗斯确实合作发布了有关希拉里·克林顿对高盛私人演讲的信息，那么我完全否认并谴责这些非法泄密行为。

source: They keep saying "Russia Russia Russia". I've heard other people say this was an inside job from a DNC whistleblower. You know, the guy that assassinated or something like that. Strange!
zh: 他们一直说“俄罗斯俄罗斯俄罗斯”。我听其他人说这是民主党全国委员会举报人的内部工作。你知道，那个暗杀的人或者类似的人。奇怪的！

source: If you're a Bernie supporter, you should be outraged by this manipulation of the democratic process. It looks like the fix was in for Crooked Hillary from the day she started running!
zh: 如果您是伯尼的支持者，您应该对这种对民主进程的操纵感到愤怒。看起来，从狡诈的希拉里开始竞选的那天起，问题就已经解决了！

source: This just shows how terrified the DNC and the political establishment are of substantive change to the system. I am the outsider candidate who will fix Washington and drain the swamp.
zh: 这恰恰说明，民主党全国委员会和政坛建制派有多害怕对体制作出实质性改革。我是一名政坛局外人，将整顿华盛顿，把这片沼泽抽干。

source: I am preparing a severe criticism of Russia as we speak, a very very strong criticism I think you'll agree. For seeking to divide us as a nation by releasing this information about Hillary Clinton and her political tricks.
zh: 在我们发言时，我正在准备对俄罗斯进行严厉的批评，我想你会同意这是一个非常非常强烈的批评。通过发布有关希拉里·克林顿的信息和她的政治伎俩来寻求分裂我们作为一个国家。

source: From the start, it's incredible that Hillary Clinton was even allowed to run. We're just fortunate that this news came out before the election. Can you imagine?!
zh: 从一开始，希拉里·克林顿甚至被允许运行就令人难以置信。我们很幸运，这个消息是在选举前发布的。你能想象吗？

source: I don't want to speculate on what kind of incriminating new evidence might be in these emails. I just want to focus on our Make America Great Again agenda during the closing stretch of this election.
zh: 我不想猜测这些电子邮件中可能存在什么样的新证据。我只想在这次选举的最后阶段关注我们的让美国再次伟大议程。

source: I love our military. We're going to do a gigantic rally in Pensacola, Florida, and we're going to win Florida on election day.
zh: 我爱我们的军队。我们将在彭萨科拉佛罗里达州举行大型集会，我们将在选举日获胜佛罗里达州。

source: The pundits might say this is crazy, but we're going to visit Michigan, Wisconsin, and Minnesota. I think I can do four, maybe five rallies in one day. Maybe six.
zh: 专家可能会说这很疯狂，但我们将访问密歇根州、威斯康星州和明尼苏达州。我想我一天可以进行四次甚至五次集会。也许是六个。

source: We're going to do some tremendous rallies in Nevada and Colorado. Some truly unbelievable rallies.
zh: 我们将在内华达州和科罗拉多州进行一些巨大的集会。一些真正令人难以置信的集会。

source: Let's not complicate this too much. The election pivots around Pennsylvania -- we're going to spend the morning in Pittsburgh and the evening in Scranton.
zh: 我们不要让这件事变得太复杂。选举围绕宾夕法尼亚州展开——我们将在匹兹堡度过早上，在斯克兰顿度过晚上。

source: Can you really blame Mike in this day and age? One false accusation or misinterpreted statement, and suddenly your entire career can be at risk.
zh: 在当今这个时代，你真的能责怪迈克吗？一项虚假指控或误解的陈述，突然间你的整个职业生涯都可能面临风险。

source: Maybe if Bill Clinton and some other people I can think of would have followed this common-sense recommendation, their lives would have been much simpler.
zh: 也许如果比尔·克林顿和我能想到的其他一些人遵循这个常识性建议，他们的生活会简单得多。

source: I understand some of the issues with this. Nobody respects women more than I do, but at the same time, I have an absolutely tremendous amount of respect for Mike Pence.
zh: 我了解其中的一些问题。没有人比我更尊重女性，但同时，我也非常尊重迈克·彭斯。

source: This is a bit of a sore point among much of the left.
zh: 这对左派来说是一个有点痛处。

source: More tweets. More pearl clutching from the media. Maybe you know something they don't?
zh: 更多推文。更多来自媒体的珍珠。也许你知道一些他们不知道的事情？

source: A couple of weeks go by, and commentators start murmuring about your "pivot" for the general election.
zh: 几周过去了，评论员开始议论你对大选的“支点”。

source: Your advisors are happier, and the Washington Post even runs a cover story about your inactive Twitter account and the implications.
zh: 你的顾问们更满意了，连《华盛顿邮报》都以封面报道讨论你不再活跃的推特账号，以及这意味着什么。

source: People note your emphasis of Pence's strong conservative credentials.
zh: 人们注意到你对彭斯强烈保守派资历的强调。

source: Pundits note your emphasis of Pence's experience and credentials.
zh: 专家注意到您对彭斯经验和资历的强调。

source: It might not be a bad idea to keep hammering away at Hillary. It could help you to make this a contest of who is more unpopular.
zh: 继续猛攻希拉里，或许是个不错的主意。这能把选举变成一场比谁更不受欢迎的较量。

source: Some think you are too restained on this issue, if that's easy to believe.
zh: 有些人认为你在这个问题上过于保守，如果这很容易相信的话。

source: You raise some eyebrows with this response, but maybe there's a point?
zh: 你的这个回答让一些人感到惊讶，但也许有道理？

source: Many think this answer strikes the wrong tone in the aftermath of tragedy.
zh: 许多人认为，在悲剧发生后，这个答案语气不对。

source: Those who love gun rights, love your answer. Others accuse you of politicizing this tragedy.
zh: 那些热爱枪支权利的人，喜欢你的回答。其他人指责你将这场悲剧政治化。

source: This is a safe, standard response to such events.
zh: 这是对此类事件的安全、标准响应。

source: Mentioning Hillary Clinton is always a good way to keep your party unified.
zh: 提及希拉里·克林顿始终是保持队伍团结的好方法。

source: Pundits saw few surprises in your acceptance speech, but you once again got your message across to millions of potential voters.
zh: 专家们在您的获奖感言中没有看到什么惊喜，但您再次向数百万潜在选民传达了您的信息。

source: Your speech struck a very populist and attacking tone, but also avoided some of the standard conservative tropes.
zh: 你的演讲语气非常民粹主义和攻击性，但也避免了一些标准的保守派比喻。

source: Your flippant attitude is an asset at times, but many conservatives have legitimate worries about your candidacy.
zh: 你轻率的态度有时是一种财富，但许多保守派人士对你的候选资格有合理的担忧。

source: This could help to keep traditional conservatives from defecting this fall.
zh: 这可能有助于防止传统保守派在今年秋天叛逃。

source: Trump University is a liability. It's probably best to change the subject as quickly as possible.
zh: 特朗普大学是一种责任。最好尽快改变话题。

source: You probably shouldn't say it out loud, but such attacks aren't the worst thing for your campaign, given how you've spoken out on this issue.
zh: 你可能不应该大声说出来，但考虑到你在这个问题上的发言方式，这种攻击对你的竞选活动来说并不是最糟糕的事情。

source: The average person is over the Benghazi episode at this point, but it's important to movement conservatives.
zh: 此时，一般人已经结束了班加西事件，但这对运动保守派来说很重要。

source: The Clintons are always good for plenty of tabloid fodder, as are you.
zh: 克林顿夫妇总是适合大量小报素材，你也是。

source: An interesting response. Pundits are surprised to see you take the high road.
zh: 一个有趣的回应。专家们惊讶地发现你走上了正路。

source: Already there is talk in the Beltway about your "pivot" for the general election.
zh: 环城公路上已经有人谈论你对大选的“支点”。

source: Already there is talk in the Beltway about your "pivot" for the general election. However, immigration reform is toxic to your core supporters.
zh: 环城公路上已经有人谈论你对大选的“支点”。然而，移民改革对你的核心支持者来说是有毒的。

source: Your campaign has been marked by a surprisingly leftist take on global trade.
zh: 您的竞选活动以令人惊讶的左翼对全球贸易的看法为标志。

source: The New York Times runs a front page story about your pivot on trade, with several hot takes for and against.
zh: 《纽约时报》在头版报道了你在贸易问题上的立场转变，支持与反对的评论都颇为尖锐。

source: Some notice your reticence to discuss abortion.
zh: 有些人注意到您对讨论堕胎保持沉默。

source: After a contentious primary, observers wonder how party stalwarts will react to such comments.
zh: 在一场有争议的初选之后，观察家们想知道政党的坚定支持者会对此类评论有何反应。

source: You aren't budging an inch from your campaign rhetoric.
zh: 你的竞选言论丝毫没有改变。

source: Some sense a veiled softening of your position on the Muslim ban.
zh: 有些人感觉到您对穆斯林禁令的立场有所软化。

source: No matter how you frame it, you are definitely moderating your position on this issue. Some even discuss a "pivot" again…
zh: 无论你如何表述，你在这个问题上的立场肯定是在缓和。有些人甚至再次讨论“转向”……

source: After the controversies of 2015, the ban doesn't play a big role in the closing stretch of the campaign.
zh: 在经历了 2015 年的争议之后，禁令在竞选的最后阶段并没有发挥重大作用。

source: On the one hand, you are criticized for ducking out on the debate. On the other hand, millions of supporters tune in to watch you inveigh against Hillary Clinton and the biased media.
zh: 一方面，你因回避辩论而受到批评。另一方面，数百万支持者收看您对希拉里·克林顿和有偏见的媒体的猛烈抨击。

source: Pundits seem to agree that Hillary Clinton was much better prepared than you, but emotions are so high that it's not clear whether it matters.
zh: 专家似乎同意希拉里·克林顿比你准备得更好，但情绪如此高涨，以至于不清楚这是否重要。

source: You were your usual self on the debate stage, but Hillary Clinton also made some significant gaffes, surprising many.
zh: 你在辩论台上一如既往，但希拉里·克林顿也犯了一些重大失态，让很多人感到惊讶。

source: This is red meat for your base.
zh: 这是给你的基地的红肉。

source: Some political opponents mock your calls for "repeal and replace",  but it's a mainstream talking point for your party.
zh: 一些政治对手嘲笑您“废除和取代”的呼吁，但这是您所在政党的主流话题。

source: You avoid a constroversial subject, but establishment Republicans do have yet another doubt about your candidacy.
zh: 你回避了一个有争议的话题，但建制派共和党人确实对你的候选资格还有另一个疑问。

source: It's not quite clear what you mean, but it doesn't seem to be an attack on the program itself.
zh: 不太清楚你的意思，但它似乎不是对程序本身的攻击。

source: The gay marriage issue is less salient in the so-called culture wars compared to guns and abortion.
zh: 与枪支和堕胎相比，同性婚姻问题在所谓的文化战争中并不那么突出。

source: Perhaps in part to your vague statements, in comparison to most other issues, gay marriage does not come up very frequently in this election.
zh: 也许部分是由于您的模糊表述，与大多数其他问题相比，同性婚姻在这次选举中并不经常出现。

source: There's not much you can do but apologize and deflect, but supporters admire your pugnacious spirit in response to this.
zh: 除了道歉和转移注意力之外，你无能为力，但支持者钦佩你对此的好斗精神。

source: There's not much you can do but apologize and deflect, but polls are definitely swinging towards Hillary Clinton in the aftermath of this video.
zh: 除了道歉和转移注意力之外，你无能为力，但在这段视频之后，民意调查肯定会转向希拉里·克林顿。

source: This is a good opening to attack Hillary Clinton after some of the recent mayhem.
zh: 在最近的一些混乱之后，这是攻击希拉里·克林顿的一个好机会。

source: Keep pressing your outsider credentials and tying Hillary to Goldman Sachs, Saudi Arabia, and so on.
zh: 继续压榨你的局外人资历，并将希拉里与高盛、沙特阿拉伯等联系在一起。

source: Advisors definitely feel that, while your motives are admirable, you are leaving an opportunity on the table.
zh: 顾问肯定认为，虽然您的动机令人钦佩，但您却留下了一个机会。

source: Your complaint about Russia Russia seems a little unprompted based on what has happened thus far. Is there something else?
zh: 根据迄今为止所发生的情况，您对俄罗斯的抱怨似乎有点自发。还有别的事吗？

source: Left-wing media is certainly not happy about yet another revelation of Hillary's ideological flexibility.
zh: 左翼媒体肯定对希拉里意识形态灵活性的再次曝光感到不高兴。

source: Keep pressing your outsider credentials and promising reform.
zh: 继续强调你的局外人资格并承诺改革。

source: Polls are swinging your way a bit in the aftermath of this announcement. Could this be the break that gets you over the hump?
zh: 在此公告发布后，民意调查略有波动。这会是让你渡过难关的突破吗？

source: Everyone who saw it agrees that your final rally was truly an epic sight to behold!
zh: 每个看过的人都同意你们的最后一场集会确实是一场史诗般的景象！

source: The level of Mike Pence's social conservatism is certainly more than most Americans are familiar with.
zh: 迈克·彭斯的社会保守主义程度肯定超出了大多数美国人所熟悉的水平。

source: The questions surrounding the so-called "Bridgegate" scandal and New Jersey aren't going away, and today Chris Christie snapped at a reporter over the issue. Was his behavior appropriate?
zh: 围绕所谓的“Bridgegate”丑闻和新泽西州的问题并没有消失，今天克里斯·克里斯蒂就这个问题向一名记者厉声斥责。他的行为合适吗？

source: To what extent will you attack Hillary Clinton for the foreign donations she has taken for the Clinton Foundation, often from Middle Eastern sources. Or, also, for her paid speeches from Goldman Sachs?
zh: 你会在多大程度上攻击希拉里·克林顿，因为她为克林顿基金会接受外国捐款，这些捐款通常来自中东。或者，还有她在高盛的付费演讲？

source: What do you have to say to conservatives who doubt your commitment to their cause in this election? Do you have any gestures to make?
zh: 对于怀疑您在这次选举中对其事业的承诺的保守派，您有什么话要说的？你有什么手势可以做吗？

source: Do you plan to promise further tax cuts as you hit the campaign trail?
zh: 您是否计划在竞选期间承诺进一步减税？

source: Just look at all the good work he did in New Jersey. This is a guy who knows how to lead, and who knows how to help us Make America Great Again.
zh: 只要看看他在新泽西州中所做的所有出色工作即可。这是一个知道如何领导、知道如何帮助我们的人让美国再次伟大。

source: Christie showed that an agenda of fiscal responsibility and pragmatic, outsider solutions can win in so-called blue states. I know this might sound crazy to the liberal media, but I will win New Jersey in this election.
zh: 克里斯蒂表明财政责任议程和务实的局外人解决方案可以在所谓的蓝州获胜。我知道这对自由派媒体来说可能听起来很疯狂，但我将在这次选举中赢得新泽西州。

source: There's a terrific video out there -- have you seen it? It's just Hillary Clinton being on both sides of every issue for almost ten minutes. And remember when we thought John Kerry was a flip-flopper?
zh: 有一个很棒的视频 - 你看过吗？只是希拉里·克林顿在每个问题上都处于正反双方近十分钟的时间。还记得当我们认为约翰·克里是一个触发器吗？

source: No matter what she says now, we know Hillary Clinton was a hawk on Iraq, she opposed gay marriage, she loved NAFTA and China, she was anti-illegal immigration, and much more. I don't know how her supporters can trust her.
zh: 无论她现在说什么，我们都知道希拉里·克林顿在伊拉克问题上是鹰派，她反对同性婚姻，她热爱北美自由贸易协定和中国，她反对非法移民，等等。我不知道她的支持者如何信任她。

source: No matter what she says sometimes, we know Hillary Clinton is weak on national security, supports open borders, radical social change, and probably gun confiscation while we're at it. I don't know how the American people can trust her.
zh: 无论她有时说什么，我们都知道希拉里·克林顿在国家安全方面很薄弱，支持开放边界、激进的社会变革，而且可能还支持没收枪支。我不知道美国人民如何信任她。

source: Let's keep the focus on illegal immigration, a strong military, tax cuts, and fixing Obamacare. We're going to Make America Great Again.
zh: 让我们继续关注非法移民、强大的军队、减税和修复奥巴马医改。我们要去让美国再次伟大。

source: They say there's a war on women, but we now have reports that Bill Clinton is a rapist and women who are coming forward, and Hillary is right there trying to silence them.
zh: 他们说这是一场针对女性的战争，但我们现在有报道称比尔·克林顿是一名强奸犯，而且一些女性挺身而出，而希拉里就在那里试图让她们保持沉默。

source: Have you seen this kid in Arkansas? He looks just like Bill Clinton but there was probably a big cover-up there too.
zh: 你在阿肯色州中见过这个孩子吗？他看起来就像比尔·克林顿，但那里可能也有很大的掩盖。

source: All of the above? This election is a war for the soul of America. There's no attack that I won't make against the Clintons.
zh: 以上都是吗？这次选举是一场关乎美国灵魂的战争。我不会对克林顿夫妇进行任何攻击。

source: I will relentlessly focus on the issues like our terrible trade deals, our decaying military, repealling and replacing the Obamacare disaster, and more.
zh: 我将坚持不懈地关注诸如我们糟糕的贸易协议、我们衰败的军队、废除和取代奥巴马医改灾难等问题。

source: I've been misrepresented a lot, you know. It's funny actually, I've always been a conservative person. A lot of people have known that from the start.
zh: 你知道，我被很多人误解了。有趣的是，其实我一直是一个保守的人。很多人从一开始就知道这一点。

source: There's a list of 20 federal judges that I will promise to make appointments from? If that will make Ted Cruz endorse me, it seems like a small price to pay.
zh: 有一份 20 名联邦法官的名单，我承诺从中进行任命？如果这能让特德·克鲁兹支持我，这似乎是一个很小的代价。

source: I think you've seen with my running mate that I take the Republican Party very seriously, and believe me, I want to see us win in November and prevent a complete disaster under Hillary Clinton.
zh: 我想你已经和我的竞选搭档一起看到我非常认真地对待共和党，相信我，我希望看到我们在 11 月获胜并防止在希拉里·克林顿下发生彻底的灾难。

source: It's pathetic how losers like Ted Cruz and Jeb Bush, these guys couldn't even get 10 percent of the vote, and now they're the judge and jury? Sad!
zh: 可悲的是，像特德·克鲁兹和杰布布什这样的失败者，这些家伙连10%的选票都拿不到，现在却成了法官和陪审团？伤心！

source: The Russians gave her $2 million. The Saudis, the Arabs, they gave her a lot. Millions from the Bank of Switzerland and Deutsche Bank. It's all about the charity, right?
zh: 俄罗斯人给了她 200 万美元。沙特人、阿拉伯人，他们给了她很多。来自瑞士银行和德意志银行的数百万美元。一切都是为了慈善事业，对吗？

source: This whole situation with the Clinton Foundation really should be against the law. You have foreign governments giving this charity millions of dollars, and that's supposed to have no effect on her Presidency?
zh: 克林顿基金会的整个情况确实应该违法。外国政府向这个慈善机构捐赠了数百万美元，这对她的总统任期应该没有影响吗？

source: If Hillary wants to go around claiming that we're corrupt somehow, I think there's more than enough ammunition here to fight back.
zh: 如果希拉里想到处声称我们腐败，我认为这里有足够的弹药来反击。

source: We're going to pass the greatest tax cut in history when I'm President, you can count on it. And we're going to fix the mess that Obama has left with this terrible economy.
zh: 当我担任总统时，我们将通过历史上最大规模的减税措施，你可以放心。我们将解决奥巴马给糟糕的经济带来的混乱。

source: I want to see us pass a gigantic tax cut for the middle and the working class. That's really where the focus should be -- we've got to get everyday Americans spending again to make this country great.
zh: 我希望看到我们通过针对中产阶级和工人阶级的大规模减税。这确实是重点所在——我们必须让美国人再次消费，让这个国家变得伟大。

source: I really want us to look into increasing the child tax credit, in closing some loopholes for the banks on Wall Street, and so on. We have some good things there that will send the right message to the American people.
zh: 我真的希望我们考虑增加儿童税收抵免，堵住银行在华尔街上的一些漏洞，等等。我们在那里有一些好的东西，可以向美国人民传达正确的信息。

source: I promised no cuts to Social Security and Medicare. And we're going to repeal and replace the Obamacare disaster. You should see how people cheer when I talk about that!
zh: 我承诺不会削减社会保障和联邦医疗保险。我们将废除并取代奥巴马医改灾难。你应该看看当我谈论这个时人们是多么欢呼！

source: Chris Christie is a fighter. And we will never apologize for our efforts to fight for the American people, whether it's in New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Ohio, or many other terrific states across this wonderful, blessed nation.
zh: 克里斯·克里斯蒂是一名战士。我们永远不会为我们为美国人民而战的努力道歉，无论是在新泽西州、宾夕法尼亚州、俄亥俄州，还是在这个美好、幸福的国家的许多其他了不起的州。

source: The media loves to do this kind of thing. They gush all over this Republican or that Republican. Then once they are on the national stage, suddenly you have a totally phony story. Last time it was Mitt. Sad!
zh: 媒体喜欢做这种事情。他们滔滔不绝地谈论这个共和党或那个共和党。然后，一旦他们登上国家舞台，你就会突然看到一个完全虚假的故事。上次是米特。伤心！

source: This is something that we're going to look into very seriously. But how does this compare to Hillary Clinton taking over $10 million from Saudi Arabia for her so-called charitable foundation?
zh: 这是我们将非常认真研究的事情。但这与希拉里·克林顿从沙特阿拉伯接收 1000 万美元用于其所谓的慈善基金会相比如何呢？

source: As someone with a long political career, this is a bit of a problem for Clinton.
zh: 作为一个有着长期政治生涯的人，这对克林顿来说是一个问题。

source: People note a bit of an attack from the left in these statements.
zh: 人们注意到这些声明中有一些来自左派的攻击。

source: Pundits note your emphasis on pragmatism, in constrast to the tone you set in the primaries.
zh: 专家们注意到您对实用主义的强调，这与您在初选中设定的基调形成鲜明对比。

source: Pundits note your emphasis on moderation, in constrast to the tone you set in the primaries.
zh: 专家们注意到您强调适度，这与您在初选中设定的基调形成鲜明对比。

source: This is music to your supporters' ears.
zh: 这对你的支持者来说是美妙的音乐。

source: Pundits accuse you of dragging this campaign into the gutter, but maybe that's the point?
zh: 专家指责你把这场竞选活动拖入了阴沟，但也许这就是重点？

source: It's a good start at least…
zh: 至少这是一个好的开始......

source: Never Trumpers wince as Ted Cruz finally endorses you.
zh: 特朗普派永远不会畏缩，因为特德·克鲁兹最终支持你。

source: You continue to cast yourself as the outsider candidate, but are you doing enough to unify conservatives? Or does it matter?
zh: 您继续将自己塑造为局外人候选人，但您在团结保守派方面做得足够吗？或者这有关系吗？

source: Anytime you can mention Hillary Clinton and Goldman Sachs in the same sentence, it's a win for you.
zh: 任何时候你能在同一句话中提及希拉里·克林顿和高盛，这对你来说都是一场胜利。

source: There are legitimate concerns about the Clinton Foundation. Are your conflicts of interest any less concerning? This is the immediate counterattack from Dems.
zh: 对克林顿基金会存在合理的担忧。您的利益冲突是否不再那么令人担忧？这是民主党立即反击。

source: There's no reason not to take an opportunity when you're given one.
zh: 当你有机会时，没有理由不抓住机会。

source: Big tax cuts for the rich are not always popular politically, but they are a definite carrot for establishment Republicans to support your campaign.
zh: 对富人的大幅减税在政治上并不总是受欢迎，但它们绝对是共和党建制派支持你的竞选活动的胡萝卜。

source: Tax cuts for the middle class are always popular.
zh: 中产阶级减税一直很受欢迎。

source: For better or worse, people are definitely calling you a new kind of Republican.
zh: 不论好坏，大家确实开始称你为一种全新的共和党人。

source: Pundits note that tax cuts have not been a big part of your stump speeches, whatever the implications may be.
zh: 专家指出，无论其含义如何，减税并不是您的巡回演讲的重要组成部分。

source: After a few days on the front pages, this story begins to take a back seat again.
zh: 在头版上出现几天后，这个故事又开始退居二线。

source: You are your usual, pugnacious self today.
zh: 今天的你还是平常好斗的你。

source: What was your rationale behind selecting Jeff Sessions as your running mate?
zh: 您选择杰夫·塞申斯作为竞选搭档的理由是什么？

source: Jeff Sessions has been there fighting with us from the beginning. And it's about loyalty. This is someone who's a tremendously loyal person who's gonna help us get a lot of terrific things accomplished.
zh: 杰夫·塞申斯从一开始就和我们一起战斗。这与忠诚有关。这是一个非常忠诚的人，他会帮助我们完成很多了不起的事情。

source: Jeff Sessions has been one of the most conservative, patriotic members of the Senate for the last two decades, fighting to fix our broken immigration system, the deficit issue, and defending our wonderful police.
zh: 杰夫·塞申斯是过去二十年来最保守、最爱国的参议院议员之一，为解决我们破碎的移民制度、赤字问题而奋斗，并捍卫我们优秀的警察。

source: The FBI really covered for Crooked Hillary on this one. We will be asking, "Where's the indictment?" every day in my speeches, and on social media.
zh: 联邦调查局在这件事上确实为狡猾的希拉里提供了掩护。我们会问：“起诉书在哪里？”每天在我的演讲和社交媒体上。

source: Hillary Clinton continues to say that I'm unqualified to serve as President, so what was going on her brain when she installed this server?
zh: 希拉里·克林顿继续说我没有资格担任总统，那么她安装这个服务器时脑子里在想什么？

source: With adversaries out there like China, Iran, Russia, North Korea, and others -- there are even people just doing weird things in their basement sometimes. She really should have been more careful.
zh: 对于中国、伊朗、俄罗斯、朝鲜等国家的对手，甚至有人有时只是在地下室做奇怪的事情。她确实应该更加小心一点。

source: There are plenty of other issues like radical Islamic terrorism, our terrible trade deals, and many others that I want to focus on in this campaign.
zh: 还有很多其他问题，例如激进的伊斯兰恐怖主义、我们糟糕的贸易协议，以及我想在这次竞选中关注的许多其他问题。

source: We're going to be incredibly strong on the Second Amendment. If you look at Hillary, she's very obviously someone who hates guns. And I mean, I'm just talking about the facts here. But we're going to make guns even more legal.
zh: 我们将在第二修正案上表现得异常强大。如果你看看希拉里，你会发现她显然是一个讨厌枪支的人。我的意思是，我只是在这里谈论事实。但我们将使枪支更加合法。

source: We're going to be incredibly pro-Second Amendment. And it's definitely a factor I'll consider as we're making appointments, you know, with judges and so on.
zh: 我们将非常支持第二修正案。当我们与法官等进行任命时，这绝对是我会考虑的一个因素。

source: I've seen some of the catastrophes we've had, and maybe something like a better background check system could help, within reason you know.
zh: 我已经看到了我们所经历的一些灾难，也许更好的背景调查系统之类的东西可以有所帮助，在你知道的合理范围内。

source: There's nothing wrong with calling out a little personal loyalty.
zh: 表达一点个人忠诚并没有什么错。

source: People note your emphasis of Sessions's strong conservative credentials.
zh: 人们注意到您对塞申斯强烈保守派资历的强调。

source: You are sounding like a true Republican on the Second Amendment.
zh: 对于第二修正案，你听起来像是一个真正的共和党人。

source: People notice, for better or worse, that you aren't a typical Republican when it comes to guns.
zh: 人们注意到，无论好坏，在枪支问题上你都不是典型的共和党人。

source: Many have started taking a second look at some of Ben Carson's past statements. Do you agree with his comparisons of Obamacare to slavery?
zh: 许多人开始重新审视本·卡森过去的一些言论。您同意他将奥巴马医改与奴隶制进行比较吗？

source: In light of your scathing and unrestrained jeremiads against Ben Carson before the Iowa Caucuses, what makes you now think that he is a good running mate?
zh: 鉴于您在艾奥瓦州预选会议之前对本·卡森的严厉和无节制的哀悼，是什么让您现在认为他是一个很好的竞选搭档？

source: Do you stand by your statements that there will be absolutely no cuts to Social Security or Medicare under a Trump Administration?
zh: 您是否坚持自己的说法，即在特朗普政府领导下绝对不会削减社会保障或联邦医疗保险？

source: Ben Carson is one of the most terrific choices we could have come up with. He's another one of those outsider figures who really got some traction in this race, and he'll help us unite our supporters accordingly.
zh: 本·卡森是我们能想到的最棒的选择之一。他是另一位在这场竞选中真正受到关注的局外人，他将帮助我们团结我们的支持者。

source: We're out here to show that we understand what it's gonna take to fix black America and open our great prosperity to all Americans. And it could be a really wonderful thing if we get people like Ben Carson in the right place to make a difference.
zh: 我们来这里是为了表明我们了解如何修复美国黑人并向所有美国人开放我们的伟大繁荣。如果我们让像本·卡森这样的人在正确的地方发挥作用，这可能是一件非常美妙的事情。

source: This is the guy who lost in 2012. He was a loser. And then he gave speeches against me from the beginning. I mean, is this really the kind of guy we want at our convention?
zh: 这是2012年失败的人。他是一个失败者。然后他从一开始就发表反对我的演讲。我的意思是，这真的是我们大会上想要的那种人吗？

source: I'm not the one who has a say in the matter. It sounds like he doesn't want to speak there anyway, and so be it.
zh: 我对此事没有发言权。听起来他无论如何都不想在那里说话，就这样吧。

source: The failing New York Times and many others have totally exaggerated this to make us look divided in the face of Hillary Clinton. I would be glad to work with Mitt and get him into the convention hall.
zh: 失败的纽约州时代和许多其他人完全夸大了这一点，使我们在面对希拉里·克林顿时显得分裂。我很高兴与米特合作并让他进入会议厅。

source: We're going to take care of people when I'm President. Absolutely no cuts to Social Security and Medicare. We have millions and millions of people relying on these programs.
zh: 当我担任总统时，我们将照顾人民。绝对不会削减社会保障和联邦医疗保险。我们有数百万人依赖这些计划。

source: You know, sometimes if the program grows by 4%, and then you do something and you don't even know you did something, especially when it's a Republican, and the program grows by 3.8%. The liberal media loves to call that a "cut".
zh: 你知道，有时如果该计划增长了 4%，然后你做了一些事情，你甚至不知道自己做了什么，特别是当它是共和党时，该计划增长了 3.8%。自由派媒体喜欢称之为“削减”。

source: Obamacare is the biggest disaster in the history of the United States in at least the last 100 years. Dr. Carson and myself, he is a medical doctor you know, we might use different words to mean the same thing.
zh: 奥巴马医改是美国历史上至少过去 100 年来最大的灾难。卡森博士和我自己，他是一名医生，你知道，我们可能会使用不同的词来表示同一件事。

source: Whatever you want to say about Obamacare, it won't be around for long when I'm President, believe me. We're going to repeal and replace the Obamacare disaster so fast, it's going to be truly something.
zh: 无论你想对奥巴马医改说什么，相信我，当我担任总统时，它不会存在太久。我们将如此迅速地废除并取代奥巴马医改灾难，这将是真正的大事。

source: Obamacare is not slavery, period. But one thing that's very unfair with the media -- they will sit there through a three hour speech and ignore the whole speech, and use one phrase in a hit piece. And who knows if he even meant to say it, or he was tired after a long day?
zh: 奥巴马医改不是奴隶制，就这样。但有一件事对媒体非常不公平——他们会坐在那里听完三个小时的演讲，而忽略整个演讲，并在热门文章中使用一个短语。谁知道他是否有意这么说，或者他在漫长的一天后累了？

source: We all say things in the heat of the moment that we might not mean later. You do it, I do it, Hillary Clinton has done it thousands of times. I was passionate about winning and I make no apologies.
zh: 我们都会在一时冲动时说出一些我们以后可能并不想说的话。你做，我做，希拉里·克林顿已经做了几千次了。我对胜利充满热情，我不会道歉。

source: I never attacked the character of Ben Carson. I have no idea where you people in the media get this stuff. He's going to make a terrific Vice President. I predict that his face will one day be on the Mt. Rushmore of Vice Presidents.
zh: 我从未攻击过本·卡森这个角色。我不知道你们媒体人从哪里得到这些东西。他将成为一名出色的副总统。我预测有一天他的脸将出现在副总统的拉什莫尔山上。

source: Behind the scenes, there are those who have their doubts about having two outsiders on one ticket.
zh: 在幕后，有人对一张票上有两个外人表示怀疑。

source: Dr. Carson is well-known in the black community, and generally respected, even if his political views are at odds.
zh: 卡森博士在黑人社区中享有盛誉，并且普遍受到尊重，即使他的政治观点存在分歧。

source: Disagreements are fine, but at some point you have to temper the open hostility towards the Republican establishment if you want to have a shot.
zh: 分歧很好，但在某些时候，如果你想尝试一下，你就必须缓和对共和党建制派的公开敌意。

source: The absence of some traditional Republican stalwarts at the convention becomes a bit of a news story, but only for a day or two.
zh: 一些传统的共和党坚定支持者缺席大会成为了一个新闻报道，但只持续了一两天。

source: You've broken a bit with orthodoxy on this issue, but your stance is popular.
zh: 你在这个问题上有点违背正统观念，但你的立场很受欢迎。

source: You may have a point, but there's no reason to back away from supporting a popular program in the midst of a campaign.
zh: 您可能有道理，但没有理由在竞选期间放弃支持受欢迎的计划。

source: Even your opponents have to chuckle a bit at this one.
zh: 即使是你的对手也不得不笑一笑。

source: What was your rationale behind selecting Sarah Palin as your running mate?
zh: 您选择莎拉·佩林作为竞选搭档的理由是什么？

source: Some advisors are privately alarmed at the long, meandering, and aggressive stump speeches that Sarah Palin is giving. Do you have any thoughts about reining her in?
zh: 一些顾问私下对莎拉·佩林发表的冗长、曲折且具有攻击性的演讲感到震惊。你有没有想过要约束她？

source: The left believes that any woman who doesn't agree with its radical agenda for America is a sellout. We know better. Sarah Palin was a very successful Governor, one of the most successful ever, really.
zh: 左派认为，凡是不认同他们那套激进美国议程的女性，都是叛徒。我们才更清楚真相。莎拉·佩林是一位非常成功的州长，说真的，是有史以来最成功的州长之一。

source: The sexist liberal media continues to blame this phenomenal woman for lazy John McCain's implosion in 2008. When I win this election, the failing New York Times will see just how wrong they've been!
zh: 性别歧视的自由媒体继续将 2008 年懒惰约翰·麦凯恩的内爆归咎于这位非凡的女性。当我赢得这次选举时，失败的纽约州时报将看到他们是多么错误！

source: I barely said a word. Now if the Democrats and their friends in the media want to rig this election with fake polls and massive voter fraud, they will see what it looks like when someone incites violence.
zh: 我几乎没说一句话。现在，如果民主党人和他们的媒体朋友想通过虚假民意调查和大规模选民欺诈来操纵这次选举，他们就会看到有人煽动暴力会是什么样子。

source: This is a total overreaction as usual. And how about the fact that the Democrats were sending fake protestors to my rallies to get these headlines up in the first place?
zh: 像往常一样，这完全是过度反应。民主党派遣假抗议者参加我的集会以首先登上头条新闻这一事实又如何呢？

source: Hillary Clinton would be a disaster for this country, her husband signed NAFTA, and now she says she wants open markets and many other things.
zh: 希拉里·克林顿对这个国家来说将是一场灾难，她的丈夫签署了北美自由贸易协定，现在她说她想要开放市场和许多其他事情。

source: You know, this is hard for me. Really it's not something I usually do, I'm very against it. But this one time, I am willing to apologize for what I said a couple of times. Emotions were heated, and I may have helped push a couple of individuals over the line.
zh: 你知道，这对我来说很难。真的，这不是我通常做的事情，我非常反对。但这一次，我愿意为我说过几次的话道歉。情绪很激烈，我可能帮助一些人越过了界限。

source: This is the kind of woman Sarah Palin is and the kind of woman we want in our campaign. Let's just remind her to keep firing away at Crooked Hillary and all the crimes and anti-woman activites of the Clinton cabal.
zh: 这就是莎拉·佩林的女性，也是我们在竞选活动中想要的女性。让我们提醒她继续向狡诈的希拉里以及克林顿阴谋集团的所有罪行和反女性活动开火。

source: It's really a ludicrous thing. You have the same people who led John McCain and Mitt Romney to defeat. And now they've given me the same terrible advice for months. We're not gonna change a thing.
zh: 这真是一件可笑的事情。你们有同样的人带领约翰·麦凯恩和米特·罗姆尼失败。现在几个月来他们都给了我同样糟糕的建议。我们不会改变任何事情。

source: I really hate to do this, but we gotta try and lower her profile. I love Sarah, she's incredible, but we need her to be incredible around the people who appreciate her incredibility.
zh: 我真的很讨厌这样做，但我们必须尝试降低她的知名度。我爱莎拉，她很不可思议，但我们需要她在欣赏她的不可思议的人身边表现得不可思议。

source: Mainstream pundits seem to think you've made a political blunder, but they've been wrong before. Meanwhile, your rallies just got even wilder.
zh: 主流专家似乎认为你犯了政治错误，但他们以前就错了。与此同时，你们的集会变得更加疯狂。

source: Your latest comments spark days of outrage in the media, and significant controversy, but as usual your supporters are fired up.
zh: 你的最新评论引发了媒体几天的愤怒和重大争议，但像往常一样，你的支持者被激怒了。

source: Some think you've gone a little too far with these comments, but as usual your supporters are fired up.
zh: 有些人认为你的这些评论有点太过分了，但像往常一样，你的支持者很兴奋。

source: Donald Trump apologizing for anything makes instant headline news.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普为任何事情道歉都会立即成为头条新闻。

source: Pundits may say it's a bad idea, but Sarah Palin can whip your crowds into a frenzy.
zh: 专家可能会说这是一个坏主意，但莎拉·佩林可以让你的人群陷入疯狂。

source: As usual, you are trusting your instincts over conventional wisdom.
zh: 像往常一样，您相信自己的直觉而不是传统智慧。

source: You can't really hide Sarah Palin. Now the media just runs stories about how you're trying to hide Sarah Palin.
zh: 你无法真正隐藏莎拉·佩林。现在媒体只是报道你如何试图隐藏莎拉·佩林。

source: Let's step back a couple years. In the run-up to the 2016 election, you have the luxury of being your party's presumptive nominee, along with a significant amount of time to prepare for the campaign. How will you take advantage of this time?
zh: 让我们退后几年。在 2016 年大选前夕，您有幸成为所在政党的推定提名人，并有大量时间准备竞选活动。您将如何利用这段时间？

source: The FBI director, James Comey, has handed down a severe criticism of your email practices while Secretary of State, though he declined to recommend any indictments. Do you have any comment?
zh: 联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米对你担任国务卿期间的电子邮件做法提出了严厉批评，尽管他拒绝建议任何起诉。您有何评论？

source: What was your rationale behind selecting Tim Kaine as your running mate?
zh: 您选择蒂姆·凯恩作为竞选搭档的理由是什么？

source: Having already lost a close nomination battle, many progressives feel let down by your choice of Tim Kaine as running mate. What is your response to this?
zh: 在一场势均力敌的提名战中落败后，许多进步人士对您选择蒂姆·凯恩作为竞选搭档感到失望。您对此有何回应？

source: To what extent will you campaign with Barack Obama, or support his presence on the campaign trail this year?
zh: 您会在多大程度上与贝拉克·奥巴马一起竞选，或支持他今年参加竞选活动？

source: While attending a 9/11 memorial event today, you were caught on video going limp and being carried into a van, apparently for medical attention. Do you have any comment?
zh: 今天参加 9/11 纪念活动时，视频拍到您跛行并被抬进一辆货车，显然是为了就医。您有何评论？

source: Do you plan to participate in the customary series of three televised debates with Donald Trump in this election cycle?
zh: 您是否计划在本次选举周期中与唐纳德·特朗普一起参加通常的三场电视辩论系列？

source: A video surfaced of Trump describing how he tried to seduce a married woman, and how he can generally kiss women or "grab them by the pussy". 14 women have also stepped forward to accuse him of assault. What is your response?
zh: 特朗普的一段视频描述了他如何试图引诱已婚妇女，以及他通常如何亲吻女性或“抓住她们的阴户”。 14名女性也站出来指控他性侵。你的回应是什么？

source: A leaked transcript from Wikileaks shows you saying in a closed-door speech at Goldman Sachs that you are "center-left, center-right" and that you support "open trade and open borders". How do you respond?
zh: 维基解密泄露的文字记录显示，您在高盛的一次闭门演讲中表示，您是“中左翼、中右翼”，并且支持“开放贸易和开放边界”。你如何回应？

source: A leaked transcript from Wikileaks shows your campaign working with members of the DNC to collaborate against the campaign of Bernie Sanders in subtle but definite ways, such as the sharing of some debate questions before a primary debate. How do you respond?
zh: 维基解密泄露的文字记录显示，您的竞选团队与 DNC 成员合作，以微妙但明确的方式合作反对伯尼·桑德斯的竞选活动，例如在初选辩论前分享一些辩论问题。你如何回应？

source: James Comey, FBI Director, has made a late announcement that additional emails have surfaced in your case, thanks to an investigation into Anthony Weiner. What are your thoughts?
zh: 联邦调查局 (FBI) 局长詹姆斯·科米 (James Comey) 最新宣布，由于对安东尼·韦纳 (Anthony Weiner) 的调查，您的案件中出现了更多电子邮件。你有什么想法？

source: We're going to hit our rolodex and solidify our campaign organization and fundraising. I'm going to hit the trail for Democrats in the 2014 midterms. We will be well-prepared to outspend Jeb Bush and we will unite the party before the primaries.
zh: 我们将使用名片盒并巩固我们的活动组织和筹款活动。我将在 2014 年中期选举中支持民主党。我们将做好充分准备，花费超过 Jeb 布什，并且我们将在初选前团结全党。

source: I will travel and make a number of paid speeches to support the Clinton Foundation's global outreach. I will write a book about some of the difficult choices I made as Secretary of State. This will flex my loyalty to Obama and my foreign policy credentials.
zh: 我将出差并发表多次有偿演讲，以支持克林顿基金会的全球推广。我将写一本关于我作为国务卿所做的一些艰难选择的书。这将考验我对奥巴马的忠诚度和我的外交政策资历。

source: I will write a book about the challenges facing America, and on my fight for healthcare access, fair pay, the environment, and the economy. From the time that I was First Lady of Arkansas until now, I have always fought to give every American a fair shake.
zh: 我将写一本关于美国面临的挑战以及我为医疗保健、公平薪酬、环境和经济而奋斗的书。从我担任阿肯色州第一夫人到现在，我一直努力让每个美国人得到公平的对待。

source: It's hard to visit certain places in the heat of a campaign. I will do a tour of the U.S. where I visit all 50 states and highlight the people we're fighting for with Obama's policies, and whom we'll keep fighting for when I'm President.
zh: 在竞选活动最激烈的时候很难去某些地方。我将访问美国所有 50 个州，并重点介绍我们为奥巴马政策而奋斗的人民，以及当我担任总统时我们将继续为之奋斗的人民。

source: The Republicans can't beat us on the issues, like raising the minimum wage or making college more affordable. So instead their allies in the right-wing media use these non-stories and innuendo to defend the privilege of the 1%. There is nothing to see here.
zh: 共和党无法在提高最低工资或提高大学学费等问题上击败我们。因此，他们的右翼媒体盟友反而利用这些非故事和含沙射影来捍卫 1% 的特权。这里没什么可看的。

source: Let's take a step back. George Bush and Dick Cheney lost over 20 million emails from their time in office. I have already turned over every relevant email from my time as Secretary of State. Anything else is a right-wing hit job.
zh: 让我们退一步。乔治·布什和迪克·切尼在任职期间丢失了超过 2000 万封电子邮件。我已经交出了担任国务卿以来的所有相关电子邮件。其他任何事情都是右翼热门工作。

source: I used the same email practices as Colin Powell and many other people in government. I was far too busy dealing with Russia, the Arab Spring, and the E.U. crisis to keep track of how IT was setting up my email system.
zh: 我使用了与科林·鲍威尔和许多其他政府人员相同的电子邮件做法。我太忙于处理俄罗斯、阿拉伯之春和欧盟问题了。跟踪 IT 如何设置我的电子邮件系统的危机。

source: This email system was a lapse in judgment, and I apologize. It was simply a matter of convenience to prevent me from carrying two phones everywhere, but if I was doing it again, I might do something different.
zh: 使用这套电子邮件系统是我判断失当，我为此道歉。当时只是图个方便，不想随处都带着两部手机；但如果重来一次，我可能会另作选择。

source: Donald Trump is already using this shooting as an excuse for his vile and unfounded attacks on an entire religion. We are better than that as a nation, and we deserve better than that from our President.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普已经利用这次枪击事件作为他对整个宗教进行卑鄙且毫无根据的攻击的借口。作为一个国家，我们比这更好，我们的总统也应该比这更好。

source: Thoughts and prayers are not enough. Every American should be outraged that the assault rifles used in these attacks are freely available and affordable.
zh: 思考和祈祷是不够的。每个美国人都应该感到愤怒，因为这些袭击中使用的突击步枪是免费提供且负担得起的。

source: My heart goes out the victims of this shooting. I will be going to Orlando in the next couple of days to pay my respects to the victims.
zh: 这次枪击事件的受害者我的心都碎了。未来几天我将前往奥兰多，向遇难者表示哀悼。

source: We don't know yet the exact motives behind this attack, but I condemn religious terrorism in the strongest terms if that is the motive. And my heart especially goes out to the Hispanic and LGBT communities that were affected by this terrible act of violence.
zh: 我们尚不知道这次袭击背后的确切动机，但如果这是动机的话，我最强烈地谴责宗教恐怖主义。我特别同情受到这一可怕暴力行为影响的西班牙裔和 LGBT 群体。

source: We need to do more for America. I have a plan to make college and health care affordable for every American, paid for by the 1%. The Republicans want to cut taxes for America's wealthiest citizens, so they can keep buying elections and asking Washington for bailouts and subsidies.
zh: 我们需要为美国做得更多。我有一项计划，让每个美国人都负担得起大学教育与医疗费用，资金由最富有的1%来承担。共和党人想为美国最富有的公民减税，让他们继续用钱操纵选举，再向华盛顿索取救助与补贴。

source: We have a wonderful, diverse, and strong party in the Democratic Party. When I'm President, we're going to raise the minimum wage. We're going to further improve Obamacare. We're going to create millions of high paying, green jobs. And we're going to make college more affordable for the next generation!
zh: 我们在民主党有一个精彩、多元化、强大的聚会。当我担任总统时，我们将提高最低工资。我们将进一步改进奥巴马医改。我们将创造数百万个高薪绿色就业岗位。我们将使下一代更负担得起大学费用！

source: There is only one choice in this election. Donald Trump is so unqualified, and vastly offensive to our ideals, that his election could be an existential disaster for the nation. I am the safe, responsible alternative who will take our country forward.
zh: 这次选举只有一个选择。唐纳德·特朗普是如此不合格，并且极大地冒犯了我们的理想，以至于他的当选可能对国家来说是一场生存灾难。我是安全、负责任的替代者，将带领我们的国家前进。

source: I have the experience to grow our economy, strengthen our military, create millions of new, high-paying jobs, and much more. I will be a President for all Americans when I am in office.
zh: 我拥有发展经济、加强军事、创造数百万个新的高薪就业机会等等的经验。当我就任时，我将成为所有美国人的总统。

source: Tim Kaine has fought for American workers and families for his entire career. He is amply qualified and ready to step in for our agenda at a moment's notice.
zh: 蒂姆·凯恩整个职业生涯都在为美国工人和家庭而奋斗。他完全有资格并准备好随时介入我们的议程。

source: Tim Kaine has served his home state of Virginia with great energy and effectiveness as a Governor and Senator. He is a hard working and honest person who can appeal to Americans across the ideological spectrum.
zh: 蒂姆·凯恩作为州长和参议员，以极大的精力和效率为家乡弗吉尼亚州州服务。他是一个勤奋、诚实的人，能够吸引不同意识形态的美国人。

source: When I'm thinking about a running-mate, I'm thinking about the person who will make the best President if, God forbid, they must step into that role. Tim Kaine has outstanding experience and judgment and I'm proud to make him my running mate.
zh: 当我想到竞选搭档时，我想到的是那个将成为最好总统的人，如果上帝保佑，他们必须扮演这个角色。蒂姆·凯恩拥有出色的经验和判断力，我很自豪让他成为我的竞选搭档。

source: Absolutely. The differences between us are much smaller than the things that unite us. We both wake up every day and fight for average Americans -- for their health care, their housing and education costs, and their personal rights.
zh: 当然。我们之间的差异远小于我们之间的差异。我们每天醒来都为普通美国人而战——为他们的医疗保健、住房和教育费用以及个人权利而战。

source: We don't really have a choice. He has far too much support in our party for us to pretend like he doesn't exist. Let's make sure to do a couple of appearances together before this is all over.
zh: 我们真的别无选择。他在我们党内拥有太多的支持，我们不能假装他不存在。让我们确保在这一切结束之前一起露面几次。

source: Donald Trump would be a disaster for the future of this country. We need to do everything we can to appeal to moderate voters who can be swayed by a qualified candidate. Bernie unfortunately complicates things on that front.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对于这个国家的未来来说将是一场灾难。我们需要尽一切努力吸引可以被合格候选人影响的温和选民。不幸的是，伯尼使这方面的事情变得复杂化。

source: My heart goes out to the victims of this terrible attack. I will give a speech in a few days about the importance of tolerance and diversity in our society.
zh: 我的心与这次可怕袭击的受害者同在。几天后我将发表演讲，讲述宽容和多样性在我们社会中的重要性。

source: My heart goes out to those affected by this terrible attack. My thoughts and prayers are with the great nation of France, and I will travel to France to pay my respects to the victims.
zh: 我的心与那些受到这次可怕袭击影响的人同在。我的思念和祈祷与伟大的法国同在，我将前往法国向遇难者表示敬意。

source: My heart goes out to the victims of this terrible attack. I will give a speech in a few days about the importance of defeating ISIS and religious extremism in all of its forms.
zh: 我的心与这次可怕袭击的受害者同在。几天后我将发表演讲，阐述击败伊斯兰国和一切形式的宗教极端主义的重要性。

source: Donald Trump is dangerously divisive and completely unqualified to serve as President. His constantly inflammatory rhetoric towards women, Muslims, Hispanics, and others is Exhibit A, and I plan to call this out repeatedly as I campaign.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普具有危险的分裂性，完全没有资格担任总统。他对女性、穆斯林、西班牙裔和其他人不断发表的煽动性言论就是证据A，我计划在竞选时反复指出这一点。

source: Donald Trump's actions and comments about women are reprehensible. It would be absurd of us not to bring that up as we campaign, along with other important issues.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普针对女性的行为和评论应受到谴责。如果我们在竞选时不将这一问题与其他重要问题一起提出来，那将是荒谬的。

source: This campaign is about our fight for hard working American families, regardless of their background. I'm not going to fall into the trap of making this election about Trump's behavior, instead of his disastrous policies.
zh: 这项活动是关于我们为辛勤工作的美国家庭而奋斗，无论他们的背景如何。我不会陷入让这次选举关注特朗普行为而不是他灾难性政策的陷阱。

source: This campaign is about my experience and ability to serve as President. We're going to focus primarily on those qualifications as I campaign. The fact that I'm a woman speaks for itself.
zh: 这次竞选是关于我担任总统的经验和能力。在我竞选时，我们将主要关注这些资格。我是一名女性这一事实本身就说明了一切。

source: The Republican playbook is very simple. Their actual policies hurt the economy, favor the rich, and drive up our nation's deficits. Since they can't win the economic debate honestly, they've created a vast, right-wing outrage machine to obfuscate their objectives.
zh: 共和党的策略非常简单。他们的实际政策损害了经济，有利于富人，并推高了我们国家的赤字。由于他们无法诚实地赢得经济辩论，他们创造了一个巨大的右翼愤怒机器来混淆他们的目标。

source: Donald Trump claims to be a different kind of politician, but he says he will double down on the failed tax cuts and policies of George Bush. What did Einstein say about the definition of insanity?
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普声称自己是一位不同类型的政治家，但他表示他将加倍努力实施乔治·布什失败的减税和政策。关于精神错乱的定义，爱因斯坦怎么说？

source: Donald Trump is dangerously uninformed and unqualified to serve as President. This campaign needs to focus on my experience and qualifications, in contrast to his utterly unserious credentials and statements.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普信息不灵通，没有资格担任总统，这是危险的。这次竞选活动需要关注我的经验和资历，而不是他完全不严肃的资历和言论。

source: Donald Trump is a dangerously divisive and corrosive influence on our society. This campaign needs to focus on his attacks against veterans, women, Hispanics, and practically any other group that he can think of.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对我们的社会产生危险的分裂和腐蚀性影响。这场竞选活动需要重点关注他对退伍军人、女性、西班牙裔以及他能想到的任何其他群体的攻击。

source: I am opposed to this idea. Why should I turn myself into a lame duck and project weakness before the voting for my first term even starts?
zh: 我反对这个想法。为什么我要在第一任期投票开始之前就把自己变成一只跛脚鸭并表现出弱点呢？

source: We must acknowledge the unique nature of this election, and of our opponent. This pledge might help reluctant moderates and far-left progressives support me for now, if they see an open primary coming in three years.
zh: 我们必须承认这次选举以及我们的对手的独特性。如果他们看到三年后举行公开初选，这一承诺可能会帮助不情愿的温和派和极左进步人士暂时支持我。

source: We need a minimum wage of at least $12 an hour, and hopefully more. I'm proud to stand with my running mate and advocate for the American worker in their fight against the 1%.
zh: 我们需要每小时至少 12 美元的最低工资，希望更多。我很自豪能与我的竞选搭档站在一起，为美国工人反对 1% 的人辩护。

source: The choice in this election is clear. I think every worker deserves to be paid a living wage, and Donald Trump doesn't. This issue is at the core of what the Democratic Party is fighting for.
zh: 这次选举的选择是明确的。我认为每个工人都应该得到生活工资，但唐纳德·特朗普却没有。这个问题是民主党所争取的核心。

source: The larger focus in this campaign is going to be my experience and my foreign policy credentials. And also on my dangerously unqualified opponent.
zh: 这次竞选的更大焦点将是我的经验和我的外交政策资历。还有我危险的、不合格的对手。

source: Barack Obama has an approval rate right now of more than 50 percent. It seems obvious that we would want to utilize him early and often.
zh: 贝拉克·奥巴马目前的支持率超过 50%。很明显，我们希望尽早并经常使用他。

source: I want Barack Obama to be actively involved in our campaign. And more specifically, I want him to really campaign hard in places like Detroit, Milwaukee, Philadelphia, and others where we need high levels of African-American support.
zh: 我希望贝拉克·奥巴马积极参与我们的活动。更具体地说，我希望他在底特律、密尔沃基、费城和其他需要大量非裔美国人支持的地方努力竞选。

source: We're going to appear with Barack and Michelle, but we need to be careful about running for the third term of Obama's Presidency. There are significant differences between us as well.
zh: 我们将与巴拉克和米歇尔一起出现，但我们需要谨慎竞选奥巴马总统的第三个任期。我们之间也存在显着差异。

source: Part of my campaign is about moving beyond the legacy of Obama and fighting more assertively for systemic ecnomic change. My focus will be more on appearing with Elizabeth Warren, Bernie Sanders, and others.
zh: 我的竞选活动的一部分是超越奥巴马的遗产，更加坚定地为系统性经济变革而奋斗。我的重点将更多地放在与伊丽莎白·沃伦、伯尼·桑德斯和其他人一起出现。

source: We need a Green New Deal. Global warming is the great challenge of our era, and we need to make every investment we can to combat it. And furthermore, we need to make tough choices on our current economic and environmental regulations.
zh: 我们需要绿色新政。全球变暖是我们这个时代面临的巨大挑战，我们需要尽一切努力来应对这一挑战。此外，我们需要对当前的经济和环境法规做出艰难的选择。

source: I will put significant effort into cutting emissions, working with our global partners, and in increasing the funding for our scientific institutions. Donald Trump, on the other hand, says this is all some conspiracy from China.
zh: 我将投入大量精力来减少排放、与我们的全球合作伙伴合作以及增加对我们科研机构的资助。另一方面，唐纳德·特朗普说这都是来自中国的阴谋。

source: The Republicans and Donald Trump want to pull us out of the Paris Accords, turn coal loose in the country, and take us back decades when it comes to environmental regulation. That won't happen when I am President.
zh: 共和党和唐纳德·特朗普希望让我们退出《巴黎协定》，在该国放开煤炭，并让我们在环境监管方面倒退几十年。当我担任总统时，这种情况就不会发生。

source: The best way to combat global warming is through the effort of American enterprise. With the right incentives, I'm confident that we will find solutions to the problems of solar and wind energy, with minimal disruptions to existing jobs and businesses.
zh: 应对全球变暖的最佳途径是通过美国企业的努力。通过正确的激励措施，我相信我们将找到太阳能和风能问题的解决方案，同时将对现有就业和企业的干扰降至最低。

source: Obamacare did not go far enough. We will fight very hard for universal health care when I am President, in whatever form that may take. This has been my fight for over 20 years now.
zh: 奥巴马医改做得还不够。当我担任总统时，我们将非常努力地争取全民医疗保健，无论采取何种形式。这已经是我20多年来的斗争了。
