source: I was very sad when the public option was taken out of the Affordable Care Act. This is something we must fight for over the coming years, along with adequate funding and controls on prices.
zh: 当公共选项被从平价医疗法案中删除时，我感到非常难过。这是我们在未来几年必须争取的目标，同时还要提供充足的资金和对价格的控制。

source: Donald Trump is a uniquely unqualified and dangerous individual to occupy the White House. He has said over and over again that he will immediately repeal Obamacare if he is President, throwing millions off their health insurance.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普是占据白宫的唯一不合格且危险的个人。他一再表示，如果他当选总统，他将立即废除奥巴马医改，从而使数百万人不再享受医疗保险。

source: I will fight hard to preserve the landmark Affordable Care Act when I am President. This program is one of Barack Obama's great legacies.
zh: 当我担任总统时，我将努力保护地标平价医疗法案。该计划是贝拉克·奥巴马的伟大遗产之一。

source: This was an ill-considered and insensitive comment on my part, and I apologize. While this is a real issue, saying it describes "half" of Trump's supporters is a definite exaggeration.
zh: 这是我考虑不周且麻木不仁的评论，我深表歉意。虽然这是一个真实的问题，但说它描述了特朗普的“一半”支持者显然是夸张的。

source: We should all be very concerned with the right-wing radicalism that Trump has enabled. It has no place in America, even if this particular remark could have been stated with more finesse.
zh: 我们都应该非常关注特朗普所促成的右翼激进主义。即使这句话可以用更巧妙的方式表达，它在美国也没有立足之地。

source: I will apologize for this remark when Trump apologizes for his "rapist" comments about Hispanics, his constant attacks on women, and his failure to condemn white supremicist supporters.
zh: 当特朗普为他对西班牙裔的“强奸”言论、他对女性的不断攻击以及他未能谴责白人至上主义支持者道歉时，我将为他的言论道歉。

source: After months of hard campaigning, what seemed to be a minor cough has turned into something more. Unfortunately it looks like I will need to take some days off from the campaign to rest and recuperate.
zh: 经过几个月的艰苦竞选，看似轻微的咳嗽已经变成了更大的问题。不幸的是，看来我需要从竞选中休息几天来休息和恢复。

source: No comment really. It's unfortunate that the right-wing media is circulating numerous unfounded rumors about by health. The people will see these are lies as I campaign vigorously over the coming weeks.
zh: 真的没有评论。不幸的是，右翼媒体正在散布许多关于健康的毫无根据的谣言。当我在未来几周大力竞选时，人们将会看到这些都是谎言。

source: This deal was one of Barack Obama's real achievements during his time in office that we will uphold and enforce. I fully support it.
zh: 这笔交易是贝拉克·奥巴马在他任职期间取得的真正成就之一，我们将维护和执行。我完全支持。

source: Like many people, I had some concerns with specific provisions in this deal. But overall, it is a worthwhile step in the right direction.
zh: 和许多人一样，我对这笔交易中的具体条款有些担忧。但总体而言，这是朝着正确方向迈出的值得的一步。

source: This is definitely something that my team will approach with fresh eyes when I am President, but I can't say more than that right now.
zh: 当我担任总统时，这绝对是我的团队将以新的眼光对待的事情，但我现在不能说更多。

source: Donald Trump says he will tear this deal up, should he somehow win this election. That is dangerous and ill-conceived, and really shows how unfit he is to guide America's foreign policy.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普表示，如果他以某种方式赢得这次选举，他将撕毁这笔交易。这是危险且考虑不周的，并且真正表明他是多么不适合指导美国的外交政策。

source: We need to be vigilant in every case, but a cap of 10 thousand people is appalingly low from any humanitarian perspective. This conflict has displaced millions, including small children and infants.
zh: 我们需要对每种情况保持警惕，但从任何人道主义角度来看，1 万人的上限都低得惊人。这场冲突已导致数百万人流离失所，其中包括儿童和婴儿。

source: We must balance the humanitarian impulse with what is practical and politically feasible. I would prefer to see us offer generous aid to Turkey, Jordan, and other affected countries as we protect people from the brutal Assad regime and defeat ISIS.
zh: 我们必须在人道主义冲动与实际和政治可行之间取得平衡。我希望看到我们向土耳其、约旦和其他受影响国家提供慷慨的援助，保护人民免受残暴的阿萨德政权的侵害并击败伊斯兰国。

source: What's happening in Syria right now is obviously tragic. The last thing we need right now is the divisive and unstable leadership of Donald Trump to make things worse.
zh: 叙利亚目前正在发生的事情显然是悲惨的。我们现在最不需要的就是唐纳德·特朗普的分裂和不稳定的领导，这会让事情变得更糟。

source: Donald Trump has already hinted that he won't accept the results of this election, and that any debate cannot be considered fair because of so-called moderator bias. I would prefer to take my case directly to the American people with 30-minute television spots.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普已经暗示他不会接受这次选举的结果，并且由于所谓的主持人偏见，任何辩论都不能被认为是公平的。我更愿意通过 30 分钟的电视广告直接向美国人民传达我的情况。

source: These debates will expose Donald Trump as woefully unprepared and unqualified to assume the position of President. I am eagerly looking forward to participating.
zh: 这些辩论将暴露唐纳德·特朗普严重没有准备好且没有资格担任总统职位。我热切地期待着参加。

source: Like many women, I was sickened and appalled to see Donald Trump bragging about assault in casual conversation. Are these the values that we stand for in America, and that we want to teach our children?
zh: 和许多女性一样，看到唐纳德·特朗普在随意谈话中吹嘘侵犯行为，我感到恶心和震惊。这些是我们在美国所代表的价值观，也是我们想要教给我们的孩子的价值观吗？

source: This video clip is just one more piece of evidence that Donald Trump is a fake conservative who doesn't share Christian values. And of course, it also shows yet again how grossly unqualified Trump is to serve as President.
zh: 该视频剪辑只是又一个证据，证明唐纳德·特朗普是一个不认同基督教价值观的假保守派。当然，这也再次表明特朗普是多么不合格担任总统。

source: This clip will show up all over the news and the internet for days. Let's continue to make our own case to the American people.
zh: 该剪辑将在新闻和互联网上出现数天。让我们继续向美国人民阐明我们自己的观点。

source: As bad as it is, this clip is just part of an even larger pattern. His insinuations about Miss Universe contestants. His strange statements about his own daughter. There's a bizarre video where he fondles Rudy Giuliani, in drag.
zh: 尽管很糟糕，但该剪辑只是更大模式的一部分。他对环球小姐参赛者的影射。他对自己女儿的奇怪言论。在一段奇怪的视频中，他抚摸着变装的鲁迪·朱利安尼。

source: This is a gross misrepresentation of my statements. I was speaking hypothetically about the future 40 or 50 years from now. And I would remind you that these statements were most likely leaked by Russian intelligence.
zh: 这是对我的陈述的严重歪曲。我是在假设 40 或 50 年后的未来。我想提醒您，这些声明很可能是俄罗斯情报部门泄露的。

source: If we look back to the days of Abraham Lincoln, one of our greatest leaders, he said that sometimes you need to have a public position and a private position on some issues to drive true progress.
zh: 如果我们回顾我们最伟大的领导人之一亚伯拉罕·林肯的时代，他说有时你需要在某些问题上拥有公开立场和私人立场才能推动真正的进步。

source: This is nothing compared to the lies and equivocation of Donald Trump. And furthermore, it's appalling that Republicans are so willing to throw aside all ideals and cooperate with the Russians, the moment it's convenient for them.
zh: 与唐纳德·特朗普的谎言和模棱两可相比，这算不了什么。此外，令人震惊的是，共和党人在他们方便的时候如此愿意抛开所有理想并与俄罗斯人合作。

source: We have already implemented reforms to the DNC to prevent this in the future. And also, the idea that the nomination was "stolen" is absurd and unfactual.
zh: 我们已经对民主党全国委员会实施了改革，以防止未来出现这种情况。而且，提名被“窃取”的想法是荒谬和不事实的。

source: Any "concern" that Republicans have for Bernie Sanders and his supporters is utterly fraudulent. Furthermore, the incidents these leaks mention are minor and had no effect on the nomination.
zh: 共和党人对伯尼·桑德斯及其支持者的任何“担忧”都是完全欺诈的。此外，这些泄密事件提到的事件都很轻微，对提名没有影响。

source: Where is the investigation into the Russian leaks? Where is the investigation into Trump's blatantly illegal business practices over many years? This is an unprecededented and outrageous act of political interference by the FBI.
zh: 对俄罗斯泄密事件的调查在哪里？对特朗普多年来公然非法商业行为的调查在哪里？这是FBI史无前例、令人发指的政治干预行为。

source: I am deeply concerned by Comey's decision to reopen a settled case, and I'm confident that there are no new revelations here. We're going to focus on our message during the closing stretch of this campaign?
zh: 我对科米决定重新审理已结案件深感担忧，并且我相信这里不会有新的披露。我们将在本次活动的最后阶段重点关注我们的信息？

source: We're going to spend our final day in Florida, rallying the Hispanic, Jewish, and black communities against the outrages of Donald Trump and his campaign.
zh: 我们将在佛罗里达州度过最后一天，团结西班牙裔、犹太裔和黑人社区，反对唐纳德·特朗普及其竞选活动的暴行。

source: We're going to visit Michigan, Wisconsin, and Minnesota. I want us to appear with Bernie Sanders and Barack Obama to push our message on trade, the African-American turnout, and party unity.
zh: 我们要去拜访密歇根州、威斯康星州和明尼苏达州。我希望我们与伯尼·桑德斯和贝拉克·奥巴马一起出现，以传达我们关于贸易、非裔美国人投票率和政党团结的信息。

source: We're going to visit Colorado and Nevada, and maybe a short stop in Arizona, to rally Hispanic turnout and highlight Trump's outrages for a final time.
zh: 我们将访问科罗拉多州和内华达州，也许会在亚利桑那州短暂停留，以提高西班牙裔投票率并最后一次强调特朗普的暴行。

source: Let's not complicate this too much. The election pivots around Pennsylvania -- we're going to spend our final day in Pennsylvania, with an enormous rally of celebrities and party heavyweights.
zh: 我们不要让这件事变得太复杂。选举围绕宾夕法尼亚州展开——我们将在宾夕法尼亚州度过最后一天，届时将举行由名人和政党重量级人物组成的大型集会。

source: I am the most progressive candidate ever for President of the United States. We are pushing for a higher minimum wage, better health care, immigration reform, and police reform. Tim Kaine stands fully behind that agenda.
zh: 我是美国总统有史以来最进步的候选人。我们正在推动提高最低工资、改善医疗保健、移民改革和警察改革。蒂姆·凯恩完全支持该议程。

source: I made my selection based on who is most qualified to serve as President, should the situation ever arise. Tim Kaine has served as a Governor and a Senator over the couse of many years, and he is a reliably progressive Democrat.
zh: 我的选择是基于谁最有资格在这种情况出现时担任总统。蒂姆·凯恩多年来担任州长和参议员，他是一位可靠的进步民主党人。

source: It turns out that you will be running against Trump, likely with a significant fundraising advantage.
zh: 事实证明，您将与特朗普竞争，很可能具有显着的筹款优势。

source: You are setting yourself up be a mainstream, establishment Democratic candidate. It seemed to work for Obama the last two times.
zh: 您正在将自己定位为主流、建制派民主党候选人。过去两次似乎对奥巴马有效。

source: Analysts and voters detect more of a populist note in your latest political persona.
zh: 分析师和选民在您最新的政治形象中发现了更多的民粹主义色彩。

source: Some wonder if it's just a cynical political ploy, but you get your face on the local news in a lot of places across the country.
zh: 有些人怀疑这是否只是一种愤世嫉俗的政治策略，但你的脸出现在全国很多地方的当地新闻上。

source: It's good to hit back hard, even if a few bloviators question how this affects your "likeability".
zh: 强烈反击是件好事，即使一些吹毛求疵者质疑这如何影响你的“好感度”。

source: Maybe your best bet here is to turn this into a "both sides" partisan story. And it's not as if you're wrong about Bush.
zh: 也许你最好的选择是将其变成“双方”党派故事。这并不是说你对布什的看法是错误的。

source: This story is having a definite effect on your campaign, unfortunately.
zh: 不幸的是，这个故事对您的竞选活动产生了明确的影响。

source: Trump's response to this shooting has been widely criticized by political commentators.
zh: 特朗普对这起枪击事件的回应受到了政治评论员的广泛批评。

source: This answer appeals to your core voters.
zh: 这个答案对你的核心选民有吸引力。

source: This is a standard, non-political response to any tragic event.
zh: 这是对任何悲剧事件的标准、非政治反应。

source: It's not yet clear whether this attack was actually terrorism. Both you and Trump are coming under some criticism for jumping to that conclusion.
zh: 目前尚不清楚这次袭击是否真的是恐怖主义。你和特朗普都因仓促得出这个结论而受到一些批评。

source: Pundits talk a lot about the surprisingly pugnacious and populist tone of your acceptance speech.
zh: 专家们经常谈论你获奖感言中令人惊讶的好斗和民粹主义语气。

source: Pundits detect the standard, Democratic talking points in your speech that will appeal to a wide variety of potential supporters.
zh: 专家们在您的演讲中发现了标准的民主党谈话要点，这些要点将吸引各种各样的潜在支持者。

source: Pundits talk a lot about you eschewed ideology to take the attack to Trump.
zh: 专家们谈论了很多关于你避开意识形态来攻击特朗普的事情。

source: Pundits conclude that your speech was somewhat moderate, unifying, and surprisingly non-controversial. Some just thought it was boring.
zh: 专家得出的结论是，您的演讲有些温和、统一，而且令人惊讶地没有争议。有些人只是认为这很无聊。

source: Tim Kaine is very popular within the party establishment, but less well known in the general public.
zh: 蒂姆·凯恩在党内非常受欢迎，但在公众中知名度较低。

source: Whatever your personal feelings, you must do something to reach out to Bernie Sanders and his legion of supporters.
zh: 无论您的个人感受如何，您都必须做一些事情来接触伯尼·桑德斯和他的支持者军团。

source: People on all sides mostly see you trying to strike a middle path on the "Bernie question".
zh: 各方人士大多认为你试图在“伯尼问题”上走一条中间道路。

source: Even close advisors feel it was probably a mistake to freeze Bernie out so aggressively from the convention, given the backlash that has ensued.
zh: 考虑到随之而来的强烈反对，即使是亲密的顾问也认为如此积极地将伯尼排除在大会之外可能是一个错误。

source: This answer has the expected supporters and detractors.
zh: 这个答案有预期的支持者和反对者。

source: This is a safe, standard response and your visit makes you look statesmanlike in contrast to Trump.
zh: 这是安全、标准的回应，与特朗普相比，您的访问让您看起来像政治家。

source: Pundits note the surprisingly strong tone of your speech about ISIS.
zh: 专家们注意到您关于 ISIS 的演讲语气出人意料地强烈。

source: It's fine to bring the attack to Trump. Just make sure to mention what you have to offer as well.
zh: 可以将攻击带到特朗普。请务必提及您必须提供的内容。

source: Your best bet is to focus both on Trump's behavior, along with other economic and social issues that Americans and Democrats find important.
zh: 你最好的选择是关注特朗普的行为，以及美国人和民主党认为重要的其他经济和社会问题。

source: You should definitely be discussing pocketbook issues on the trail, but don't forget how unpopular Trump is as well.
zh: 你绝对应该在旅途中讨论钱包问题，但不要忘记特朗普也是多么不受欢迎。

source: You should definitely be discussing your qualifications on the trail, but don't forget how unpopular Trump is as well.
zh: 你绝对应该在赛道上讨论你的资格，但不要忘记特朗普也是多么不受欢迎。

source: This talking point seems to play well among voters, even if it makes party insiders a little nervous about the direction of your potential Administration.
zh: 这个话题似乎在选民中很受欢迎，即使它让党内人士对你的潜在政府的方向有点紧张。

source: George Bush did not leave office as a popular President. Maybe you can make the case that, underneath everything, Trump and Bush aren't so different after all?
zh: 乔治·布什没有以受欢迎的总统身份卸任。也许你可以证明，在一切的背后，特朗普和布什并没有那么不同？

source: You seem to be betting that you can win over disaffected moderates with repeated attacks on Trump's inexperience and behavior.
zh: 你似乎打赌，你可以通过反复攻击特朗普的经验不足和行为来赢得心怀不满的温和派。

source: It's not like anyone is asking you to comment on this, but it could have been an interesting gambit, given the stakes of this election.
zh: 并不是有人要求您对此发表评论，但考虑到这次选举的利害关系，这可能是一个有趣的策略。

source: It's unclear what effect this will have, but it is an interesting move.
zh: 目前还不清楚这会产生什么影响，但这是一个有趣的举动。

source: Can you turn out enough of the base to make up for disaffecting some moderate voters?
zh: 你能拿出足够的支持来弥补一些温和派选民的不满吗？

source: Can you win enough swing voters to compensate for tepid enthusiasm within your base?
zh: 你能赢得足够多的摇摆选民来弥补你的基地内不温不火的热情吗？

source: There's nothing wrong with embracing Barack Obama this fall.
zh: 今年秋天拥抱贝拉克·奥巴马并没有什么问题。

source: Obama emphasizes turnout repeatedly in his speeches across these areas.
zh: 奥巴马在这些领域的演讲中反复强调投票率。

source: There are a few unwanted rumors out there that you and Obama don't totally get along. Unless you wanted those to leak out?
zh: 有一些不受欢迎的谣言称您和奥巴马相处得不好。除非你想让那些泄露出去？

source: You can run a more assertively populist campaign without completely throwing Obama overboard.
zh: 您可以开展更加自信的民粹主义竞选活动，而无需完全抛弃奥巴马。

source: People notice your surpisingly strong tone on global warming.
zh: 人们注意到你对全球变暖问题的强硬态度。

source: Your attack on coal country is what makes the headlines, for better or worse.
zh: 无论好坏，你对煤炭国家的攻击都是头条新闻。

source: This comes off as a very market-focused philosophy in combatting global warming.
zh: 这是一种非常以市场为中心的应对全球变暖的理念。

source: Unfortunately, an ill-timed health issue has cost you several days of appearances during a critical part of the campaign.
zh: 不幸的是，一个不合时宜的健康问题让您在竞选的关键部分缺席了几天。

source: After a couple of days, the health issue recedes to the background.
zh: 几天后，健康问题就退居幕后了。

source: You are campaigning hard, but several times you break out into uncontrolled coughing fits that don't escape public notice.
zh: 你正在努力竞选，但有几次你突然爆发不受控制的咳嗽，这并没有逃脱公众的注意。

source: Unfortunately, your decision to keep campaigning has really backfired. Your health issue has gotten worse, forcing you to take a significant break from the campaign in October.
zh: 不幸的是，你继续竞选的决定确实适得其反。你的健康问题变得更糟，迫使你在十月的竞选活动中大幅休息。

source: Your 30-minute TV spots have terrible ratings, and Trump doesn't hesitate to mock you for it on Twitter.
zh: 你的 30 分钟电视节目收视率很糟糕，特朗普会毫不犹豫地在 Twitter 上嘲笑你。

source: Pundits seem to think that you did surprisingly poorly against Trump, even if he was his usual wild self.
zh: 专家们似乎认为你在对阵特朗普时表现出奇的糟糕，即使他还是平时狂野的自己。

source: Your debate performances are widely praised, especially compared to Trump. Will it matter with the voters?
zh: 你的辩论表演受到广泛好评，特别是与特朗普相比。这对选民来说重要吗？

source: Trump's comments dominate the airwaves for several days, and even bring some condemnation from notable conservatives.
zh: 特朗普的言论连续几天占据了电视广播的主导地位，甚至招致了一些著名保守派人士的谴责。

source: After days of Trump's "grab them by the pussy" comments dominating the news, the story begins to move on to other things, not the least of which is these leaks.
zh: 在特朗普的“抓住他们的阴部”评论占据新闻头几天之后，故事开始转向其他事情，其中​​最重要的是这些泄密。

source: After a few days, Comey does announce that no new evidence was found. Unfortunately for you, there was a definite effect on the polls as early voting began.
zh: 几天后，科米确实宣布没有发现新的证据。对你来说不幸的是，随着提前投票的开始，民意调查受到了一定的影响。

source: It's not hard to notice your progressive emphasis with this answer.
zh: 不难注意到您在这个答案中逐渐强调的内容。

source: Fighting for the rebirth of a public option is a mainstream position for the Democrats.
zh: 争取公共选择的重生是民主党的主流立场。

source: Supports and opponents both note that you are not really rocking the boat on this issue.
zh: 支持者和反对者都指出，你在这个问题上并没有真正造成影响。

source: It may have been an off-the-cuff statement, but it has erupted onto the headlines, likely to your detriment.
zh: 这可能是一个即兴陈述，但它已经成为头条新闻，可能对您不利。

source: Whatever else people can say about this campaign, it certainly hasn't lacked in verbal combat between you and Mr. Trump.
zh: 无论人们对这次活动还有什么看法，它肯定不乏你和特朗普先生之间的口水战。

source: Behind the scenes, Obama is not too pleased with your lukewarm stance. One way or another, rumors of a rift leak into the political press.
zh: 在幕后，奥巴马对你冷淡的态度不太满意。不管怎样，政治媒体中流传着两人之间关系不和的谣言。

source: Your talk about an “appallingly low” level and “millions” of refugees immediately starts the right-wing rumor mill churning about your refugee plans.
zh: 你关于“低得惊人”的水平和“数百万”难民的言论立即引发了右翼谣言工厂对你的难民计划的炒作。

source: Some of your supporters are upset that you aren't taking a stronger stand on admitting Syrian refugees.
zh: 您的一些支持者对您在接纳叙利亚难民问题上没有采取更强硬的立场感到不安。

source: Some critics are saying that Cory Booker's resume is a little thin to be named as your running mate, and that you are dangerously close to pandering. What is your response?
zh: 一些批评者说，科里·布克的简历被任命为你的竞选搭档有点单薄，而且你接近迎合的危险。你的回应是什么？

source: What is your position on the Trans-Pacific Partnership? Would you pursue further trade agreements as President?
zh: 您对跨太平洋伙伴关系持什么立场？作为总统，您会寻求进一步的贸易协定吗？

source: Cory Booker and I will both fight to ensure that all Americans have health care, economic security, and acess to clean water. I'm proud to name him as my running mate.
zh: 科里·布克和我都将努力确保所有美国人都有医疗保健、经济安全和获得清洁水。我很自豪地任命他为我的竞选搭档。

source: Cory Booker has been a tireless advocate on behalf of the people of New Jersey, and on behalf of African-Americans everywhere. He will make sure that all groups have the voice they deserve in my Administration.
zh: 科里·布克一直是代表新泽西州人民和世界各地非裔美国人的不懈倡导者。他将确保所有团体在我的政府中拥有应有的发言权。

source: Cory Booker really impressed me with his thoughtfulness, intelligence, experience, and ability to step in at a moment's notice, should the situation demand it.
zh: 科里·布克他的深思熟虑、智慧、经验以及在情况需要时立即介入的能力给我留下了深刻的印象。

source: Donald Trump's actions and comments about women are reprehensible. It would be asburd of us not to bring that up as we campaign, along with other important issues.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普针对女性的行为和评论应受到谴责。如果我们在竞选时不把这个问题和其他重要问题一起提出来，那就太荒唐了。

source: The level of disruption from globalization has simply been too much for American workers over the past few years. I don't support TPP, and there will be a pause on any new trade deals during my Presidency.
zh: 过去几年，全球化的破坏程度对于美国工人来说实在是太大了。我不支持TPP，在我担任总统期间任何新的贸易协议都将暂停。

source: I was a supporter of this deal at first, but I'm very disappointed to see some of the provisions that made it into the final version. I unfortunately cannot support the TPP at this point.
zh: 我一开始是这项协议的支持者，但我对最终版本中的一些条款感到非常失望。遗憾的是，我目前无法支持 TPP。

source: As it stands, this deal is a step in the right direction, but I have some real concerns as well. We're going to seriously reevaluate this deal when I'm in office, and work to renegotiate certain aspects of it.
zh: 就目前情况而言，这笔交易是朝着正确方向迈出的一步，但我也有一些真正的担忧。当我上任时，我们将认真重新评估这笔交易，并努力重新谈判其中的某些方面。

source: The TPP is a key piece of our battle against excessive Chinese influence in Asia, and it will lead to greater economic growth here in the United States. I support Barack Obama's efforts to pass this deal.
zh: TPP 是我们对抗中国在亚洲过度影响力的关键一环，它将带来美国更大的经济增长。我支持贝拉克·奥巴马为通过这项交易所做的努力。

source: I think it's obvious that we plan to spend a lot of time campaigning with Bernie Sanders, and that we're making a real effort to incorporate his message into our campaign.
zh: 我认为很明显，我们计划花费大量时间与伯尼·桑德斯一起开展竞选活动，并且我们正在努力将他的信息纳入我们的竞选活动中。

source: I want us to do a high-profile appearance with Bernie in Michigan, once the campaign gets going. We don't agree on every issue, but I want to embrace his economic message and show people that our party is unified.
zh: 一旦活动开始，我希望我们与伯尼一起在密歇根州中高调亮相。我们并非在所有问题上都达成共识，但我想接受他的经济信息，并向人们表明我们党是团结的。

source: Bernie Sanders has offered to campaign extensively on our behalf, and of course we want to have him on the trail. I'm willing to make a few small promises to make that happen.
zh: 伯尼·桑德斯已提出代表我们进行广泛的竞选活动，当然我们希望让他参与其中。我愿意做出一些小承诺来实现这一目标。

source: I'd love to have Bernie Sanders out there campaigning for us, but the things he is asking for are simply unrealistic. I'm not going to sit here and bargain away my platform when I'm the one who won the nomination.
zh: 我很想让伯尼·桑德斯为我们竞选，但他要求的东西根本不现实。当我赢得提名时，我不会坐在这里讨价还价我的政治纲领。

source: Donald Trump is lying when says he opposed the war. I challenge him to produce a single public statement that he made before the Iraq War started -- as opposed to years after the fact.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普说他反对战争是在撒谎。我要求他发表一份他曾发表过的公开声明 之前 伊拉克战争开始了——而不是几年后。

source: Donald Trump has shown an alarming lack of knowledge about even the basics of U.S. foreign policy. He would set us back many, many years on our objectives in Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and elsewhere.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普甚至对美国外交政策的基础知识也缺乏了解，令人震惊。他将使我们在欧洲、亚洲、中东和其他地方的目标倒退很多很多年。

source: If I knew what I know now, I wouldn't have voted "yes". But real culprit of this war was George Bush and the Republicans, using faulty intelligence.
zh: 如果我知道我现在所知道的，我就不会投票“是”。但这场战争的真正罪魁祸首是乔治·布什和共和党，他们使用了错误的情报。

source: My vote in favor of this authorization was one of the toughest of my career. And I will admit, the war didn't go as well as Bush promised it would. But ultimately, we removed a murderous dictator and replaced him a parliamentary democracy.
zh: 我对这项授权的投票是我职业生涯中最艰难的投票之一。我承认，战争并没有像布什所承诺的那样进行。但最终，我们推翻了一位凶残的独裁者，取而代之的是议会民主制。

source: I will stand behind the "red lines" that we have set, and I will take vigorous action to defend the Syrian people against Assad, Russia, Iran, ISIS, and other malevolent influences.
zh: 我将站在我们设定的“红线”后面，并采取积极行动，保护叙利亚人民免受阿萨德、俄罗斯、伊朗、伊斯兰国和其他恶意影响。

source: There are no good options in Syria. We need to continue our support for the moderate rebels, and we need to defeat ISIS wherever they appear. I also support extensive aid and funding to countries that are bearing the brunt of the refugee problem.
zh: 叙利亚没有好的选择。我们需要继续支持温和的叛乱分子，我们需要击败任何出现的伊斯兰国。我还支持向遭受难民问题首当其冲的国家提供广泛的援助和资金。

source: Unfortunately, we are limited in what we can reasonably do in Syria. I support the creation of a safe zone in Syria, for opponents of ISIS and the Assad regime, that we will defend and provide aid to. Hopefully this can limit the humanitarian damage and refugee flows.
zh: 不幸的是，我们在叙利亚能做的合理事情是有限的。我支持在叙利亚为伊斯兰国和阿萨德政权的反对者建立一个安全区，我们将保卫这个安全区并为其提供援助。希望这能够限制人道主义损害和难民潮。

source: Victory in the Syrian Civil War for moderate rebel forces is an impossibility. We need to use our strength to negotiate a peace settlement that will protect their interests and lives, and get our troops out.
zh: 对于温和的叛军来说，在叙利亚南北战争取得胜利是不可能的。我们需要利用我们的力量来谈判达成一项和平解决方案，以保护他们的利益和生命，并让我们的军队撤离。

source: We take the issues affecting minority communities very seriously. We're going to push for police reform, clean water, economic justice, and we're going to denounce Trump's dangerous and hateful rhetoric.
zh: 我们非常重视影响少数群体社区的问题。我们将推动警察改革、清洁水、经济正义，我们将谴责特朗普的危险和仇恨言论。

source: Cory Booker has more experience in public service than Donald Trump by a mile. He is a sitting U.S. Senator. Any insinuation that he somehow isn't qualified is simply a phony attack by the right-wing outrage machine.
zh: 科里·布克在公共服务方面的经验比唐纳德·特朗普多得多。他是现任美国参议员。任何暗示他不合格的暗示都只是右翼愤怒机器的虚假攻击。

source: Pundits speculate on your attempts to recreate the "Obama coalition" with your running-mate.
zh: 专家猜测你试图与你的竞选搭档重建“奥巴马联盟”。

source: While some say this is yet another changed position on your part, it could help mend fences with the left of your party.
zh: 虽然有人说这是你立场的又一次改变，但它可能有助于修补与你的政党左翼的关系。

source: There are pros and cons to embracing Bernie so closely.
zh: 如此紧密地拥抱伯尼有利也有弊。

source: Who knows if it means anything nationally, but a raucous crowd turned out to support the two of you.
zh: 谁知道这在全国范围内是否意味着什么，但是喧闹的人群来支持你们两个。

source: The reluctance of Bernie to endorse you after a couple of personal meetings fuels rampant speculation about the causes.
zh: 伯尼在几次私人会议后不愿支持你，这引发了对其原因的广泛猜测。

source: Television commentator Sean Hannity recounts a single, private conversation between himself and Trump in 2003 where Trump said he opposed the war.
zh: 电视评论员 Sean Hannity 讲述了 2003 年他与特朗普之间的一次私人谈话，其中特朗普表示他反对战争。

source: “Clinton defends Iraq War” is the headline today. Your statement might be factually accurate, but it's out of step with the views of most in your party.
zh: “克林顿捍卫伊拉克战争”是今天的标题。你的说法可能实际上是准确的，但与你党内大多数人的观点不一致。

source: Most respected economists are highly critical of trade restrictions and protectionism, yet your running-mate is well known for espousing these positions. Is that something you also embrace?
zh: 最受尊敬的经济学家对贸易限制和保护主义持高度批评态度，但你的竞选搭档却以拥护这些立场而闻名。这也是你所拥抱的吗？

source: Sherrod Brown is serious about ensuring that all workers are well paid, and protected from the impact of unfair trade deals. We're going to give him a significant voice in my Administration.
zh: 谢罗德·布朗认真确保所有工人获得高薪，并受到保护，免受不公平贸易交易的影响。我们将让他在我的政府中拥有重要的发言权。

source: Sherrod Brown has served his home state of Ohio for most of his life, fighting for workers and everyday people. He has won numerous statewide elections there as well.
zh: 谢罗德·布朗大半生都在为他的家乡俄亥俄州服务，为工人和普通人而战。他还在那里赢得了多次全州选举。

source: Sherrod Brown has served as a Congressman and Senator for over 20 years, tirelessly advocating for the American people. He has the experience and qualifications that we need in our Administration.
zh: 谢罗德·布朗担任国会议员和参议员 20 多年，孜孜不倦地为美国人民辩护。他拥有我们政府所需的经验和资格。

source: The fact of the matter is, the deficit just isn't as important as some people make it out to be. If every person has access to a quality education and reliable health care, the economy will grow enough over time to make the deficit a non-issue.
zh: 事实是，赤字并不像某些人想象的那么重要。如果每个人都能获得优质教育和可靠的医疗保健，随着时间的推移，经济将增长到足以使赤字不再是问题。

source: Republicans rave about the deficit when a Democrat is President. But when it's time to cut taxes for the top 1%, suddenly it's not an issue any more. I wonder why that is?
zh: 当民主党担任总统时，共和党人对赤字赞不绝口。但当到了为最顶层 1% 的人减税的时候，突然间这不再是问题了。我想知道这是为什么？

source: Republican tax cuts from Reagan and Bush have driven the fiscal condition of this country into a dire condition. Now Donald Trump says he wants to cut taxes for the rich even more.
zh: 共和党的里根和布什减税措施已使该国的财政状况陷入困境。现在唐纳德·特朗普说他想进一步为富人减税。

source: We need to make the tough choices that will get our sprawling deficit under control. I will increase taxes on the 1% and continue the significant progress that Barack Obama has made in reducing our annual deficit.
zh: 我们需要做出艰难的选择，以控制我们庞大的赤字。我将增加 1% 的税收，并继续贝拉克·奥巴马在减少年度赤字方面取得的重大进展。

source: In a perfect world, with fair trade, then more trade is always better. But we cannot be blind to the fact that China and other countries are cheating and ignoring many provisions of our trade deals, and deeply harming American workers in the process.
zh: 在公平贸易的完美世界中，贸易越多越好。但我们不能忽视这样一个事实：中国和其他国家正在欺骗和无视我们贸易协定中的许多条款，并在此过程中深深伤害了美国工人。

source: Sherrod Brown also happens to be a deeply qualified Senator with extensive experience in government. And we must admit that the current system isn't working for places like Ohio, Pennsylvania, Michigan, and others.
zh: 谢罗德·布朗也恰好是一位资深参议员，拥有丰富的政府经验。我们必须承认，当前系统不适用于俄亥俄州、宾夕法尼亚州、密歇根州等地方。

source: Pundits note that Sherrod Brown is a surprisingly populist choice, and immediately focus on the implications for the rust belt.
zh: 专家指出，谢罗德·布朗是一个令人惊讶的民粹主义选择，并立即关注锈带的影响。

source: Pundits note that Sherrod Brown is a surprisingly populist choice, and immediately focus on the implications for Ohio and the rust belt.
zh: 专家指出，谢罗德·布朗是一个令人惊讶的民粹主义选择，并立即关注对俄亥俄州和锈带的影响。

source: Some mainstream economists question your logic on this issue, but this position plays well on the left.
zh: 一些主流经济学家质疑你在这个问题上的逻辑，但这个立场在左派中发挥得很好。

source: Right-wing media spins your promise to raise taxes. The left is concerned about what exactly your "tough choices" will be.
zh: 右翼媒体歪曲你加税的承诺。左派担心你的“艰难选择”到底是什么。

source: What was your rationale behind selecting Bernie Sanders as your running mate?
zh: 您选择伯尼·桑德斯作为竞选搭档的理由是什么？

source: Some of your most ardent supporters, including some major donors, are wondering about your judgment in selecting Bernie Sanders as a running mate. Can you say something to reassure them?
zh: 你的一些最热心的支持者，包括一些主要捐助者，想知道你选择伯尼·桑德斯作为竞选搭档的判断。你能说些什么让他们放心吗？

source: Bernie Sanders is going to be a very active part of my Administration. We both want what's best for this country and his input will be taken very seriously.
zh: 伯尼·桑德斯将成为我的政府中非常活跃的一部分。我们都希望为这个国家带来最好的结果，他的意见将得到非常认真的对待。

source: The differences between us are much smaller than the things that unite us. We both wake up every day and fight for average Americans -- for their health care, their housing and education costs, and their personal rights.
zh: 我们之间的差异远小于将我们团结在一起的事物。我们每天醒来都为普通美国人而战——为他们的医疗保健、住房和教育费用以及个人权利而战。

source: During the past few months, our party has spoken, and we can't deny that Bernie Sanders enjoys a huge amount of support. It's only right that we join forces, and together prevent any possibility of a Trump Administration.
zh: 在过去的几个月里，我们党已经发声了，我们不能否认伯尼·桑德斯享有大量的支持。我们联手并共同防止任何特朗普政府的可能性是正确的。

source: They're going to wish they had confirmed him, once I am elected President. This choice is overly conciliatory, when we consider it was made in the face of a colossally obstructionist strategy on the part of the Republicans.
zh: 一旦我当选总统，他们会希望他们已经确认了他的提名。当我们认为这个选择是在共和党采取巨大的阻挠策略的情况下做出的，就显得过于安抚了。

source: The Republican obstruction is a clear and obvious attempt to subvert democratic norms. We should all be very concerned about this move, and I will stand by the nomination of Merrick Garland when I am elected.
zh: 共和党的阻挠是明显的颠覆民主规范的企图。我们都应该非常关注这一举动，当我当选时我将支持梅里克·加兰的提名。

source: The fact of the matter is, we as Democrats don't have the power to stop this. We need to make sure that we can win enough states, red states even, to contest the Senate over the next few years.
zh: 事实是，我们作为民主党人没有权力阻止这一切。我们需要确保我们能够赢得足够的州，甚至是红色州，在未来几年内争夺参议院席位。

source: I will not deport any undocumented immigrant who is working hard and playing by the rules in this country, that is correct.
zh: 我不会驱逐任何在这个国家努力工作并遵守规则的无证移民，这是正确的。

source: That's not quite what I said, actually. I was only referring to immigrants who have been in this country for many years and integrated into their communities.
zh: 实际上，这并不完全是我所说的。我只是指在这个国家生活多年并融入社区的移民。

source: Let's talk about Donald Trump's proposals. He would deport millions of undocumented immigrants, tearing holes in their communities and ravaging regional economies. And let's not get started on the Wall...
zh: 我们来谈谈唐纳德·特朗普的建议。他将驱逐数百万无证移民，破坏他们的社区并破坏地区经济。我们先不要从柏林墙开始……

source: We must acknowledge that illegal immigration is a serious problem. Now unlike Donald Trump, I support dealing with that problem in a humane way, but ultimately we do need reform with tougher enforcement, and a path to legal status for some immigrants.
zh: 我们必须承认非法移民是一个严重的问题。现在与唐纳德·特朗普不同，我支持以人道的方式处理这个问题，但最终我们确实需要通过更严格的执法进行改革，并为一些移民提供获得合法身份的途径。

source: Bernie Sanders and I have some differences, but we have far more in common. We cannot allow petty disputes to divide our party in the face of a potential Trump Administration.
zh: 伯尼·桑德斯和我有一些差异，但我们有更多共同点。面对潜在的特朗普政府，我们不能允许小纠纷分裂我们的政党。

source: We need to remember how the past several months transpired, and the strength that Bernie enjoys among the grassroots. Simply ignoring him was not an option for our campaign.
zh: 我们需要记住过去几个月是如何发生的，以及伯尼在草根阶层中所享有的力量。对于我们的竞选活动来说，简单地忽视他并不是一个选择。

source: Pundits have taken to callng you two "the odd couple", but Sanders is very popular with a variety of voter blocks.
zh: 专家们称你们两个为“奇怪的情侣”，但桑德斯很受各种选民群体的欢迎。

source: This is a good response to fire up the base.
zh: 这是启动基地的良好回应。

source: Some commentators sense a bit of small-c conservatism in your answer.
zh: 一些评论员感觉您的回答有点保守。

source: Pundits on both the left and the right debate your about-face on this issue.
zh: 左翼和右翼专家都在争论你在这个问题上的态度转变。

source: Calling illegal immigration a “serious problem” raises some eyebrows on the left. But other people hear you as well.
zh: 称非法移民为“严重问题”引起了一些左翼人士的不满。但其他人也能听到你的声音。

source: Do you think America is ready for a ticket with two women on it? And what does Elizabeth Warren bring to the table, electorally?
zh: 你认为美国准备好迎接一张竞选组合了吗？ 二 女人就可以了吗？伊丽莎白·沃伦在选举中会带来什么？

source: Elizabeth Warren is out in front on the issues of debt forgiveness, economic fairness, and in fighting the influence of Wall Street on American policy. She will help us fight the unfair influence of the 1%.
zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦在债务减免、经济公平以及对抗华尔街对美国政策的影响方面处于领先地位。她将帮助我们对抗1%的不公平影响。

source: Elizabeth Warren has admirably served Massachusetts as a Senator, and she will bring that experience and ability to the national stage as my Vice President.
zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦令人钦佩地担任马萨诸塞州参议员，她将作为我的副总统将这种经验和能力带到国家舞台。

source: There is no one more capable and thoughtful whom we've talked to than Elizabeth Warren. She understands the issues that this country faces, and how to be an effective leader in addressing them.
zh: 在我们交谈过的人中，没有人比伊丽莎白·沃伦更有能力、更有思想。她了解这个国家面临的问题，以及如何成为解决这些问题的有效领导者。

source: We have seen one Presidential ticket after another with two men on the ticket. Let's give women a fair shake for once! I'm confident our supporters will be motivated and galvanized by the Clinton-Warren ticket.
zh: 我们看到一张又一张总统票上有两名男子。让我们给女性一次公平的对待吧！我相信我们的支持者会被克林顿-沃伦票所激励和鼓舞。

source: Elizabeth Warren has been out in front on the issues of student loan debt, consumer finance, and bankruptcy. She is a deeply intelligent woman whom I'm proud to share a ticket with.
zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦在学生贷款债务、消费金融和破产问题上一直处于领先地位。她是一位非常聪明的女性，我很自豪能与她分享一张票。

source: Headlines like, "Is America Ready for Two Women?" proliferate, for better or worse.
zh: 诸如“美国准备好迎接两个女人了吗？”之类的标题扩散，无论好坏。
